examples.en: The secretary will transcribe the meeting notes.
examples.zh: 祕書會把會議記錄謄寫下來。

examples.en: I need to transcribe this interview for my class.
examples.zh: 我需要把這段訪談轉成文字，作為課堂作業。

examples.en: The students transcribed the poem into their notebooks.
examples.zh: 學生們把這首詩抄寫到筆記本裡。

examples.en: The transcription of the speech took two hours.
examples.zh: 這段演講的文字轉錄花了兩個小時。

examples.en: Please check the transcription for any mistakes.
examples.zh: 請檢查這份轉錄稿有沒有錯誤。

examples.en: The software offers automatic transcription of voice messages.
examples.zh: 這套軟體提供語音訊息的自動轉錄功能。

examples.en: The old transformer near our house stopped working.
examples.zh: 我們家附近那台舊變壓器壞了。

examples.en: A transformer changes the voltage of electricity.
examples.zh: 變壓器能改變電的電壓。

examples.en: The technician replaced the transformer to restore power to the building.
examples.zh: 技師更換變壓器，讓大樓恢復供電。

examples.en: The rain brought only transient relief from the summer heat.
examples.zh: 這場雨只為夏季的酷熱帶來短暫緩解。

examples.en: He felt a transient pain in his arm.
examples.zh: 他的手臂感到一陣短暫的疼痛。

examples.en: Fame can be transient for many young singers.
examples.zh: 對許多年輕歌手來說，名氣可能是短暫的。

examples.en: The hotel is mainly used by transients.
examples.zh: 這家旅館主要是給短期住客使用。

examples.en: A transient stayed in the town for only a week.
examples.zh: 一名過客在這個小鎮只待了一個星期。

examples.en: The farm hired a few transients for the harvest.
examples.zh: 農場為了收成僱用了幾名臨時工。

examples.en: A transistor is a small part inside most electronic devices.
examples.zh: 電晶體是大多數電子產品裡的一個小零件。

examples.en: My grandfather still listens to the news on his old transistor.
examples.zh: 我爺爺仍用他那台舊電晶體收音機聽新聞。

examples.en: The engineers designed a faster transistor for the new phone.
examples.zh: 工程師為新手機設計了一款速度更快的電晶體。

senses.zh: 透明度；公開程度；透明投影片

examples.en: The glass has a high degree of transparency.
examples.zh: 這片玻璃的透明度很高。

examples.en: Citizens want more transparency from the government.
examples.zh: 市民希望政府能更公開透明。

examples.en: The teacher put a transparency on the old projector.
examples.zh: 老師把一張投影片放在舊的投影機上。

examples.en: The accident was a traumatic experience for the child.
examples.zh: 那場意外對這個孩子來說是一次創傷經驗。

examples.en: Moving to a new school can be traumatic for some students.
examples.zh: 轉學對某些學生來說，可能造成心理創傷。

examples.en: She still remembers the traumatic night of the storm.
examples.zh: 她仍記得暴風雨那個令人痛苦的夜晚。

examples.en: The train will traverse the mountains in six hours.
examples.zh: 這班火車會在六小時內穿越群山。

examples.en: We had to traverse a narrow bridge to reach the village.
examples.zh: 我們必須越過一座窄橋才能到達村莊。

examples.en: The hikers traversed the desert in two days.
examples.zh: 登山客用兩天的時間橫越了沙漠。

examples.en: The road was treacherous after the heavy snow.
examples.zh: 大雪過後，那條路非常危險。

examples.en: A treacherous friend told everyone her secret.
examples.zh: 一個背信的朋友把她的祕密告訴了所有人。

examples.en: The mountain trail is treacherous in the rainy season.
examples.zh: 這條山徑在雨季時十分危險。

examples.en: Please tread carefully on the wet floor.
examples.zh: 在濕地板上請小心行走。

examples.en: Don't tread on the grass in the park.
examples.zh: 不要踩公園裡的草地。

examples.en: I tried to tread lightly so I would not wake the baby.
examples.zh: 我盡量放輕腳步，免得吵醒寶寶。

senses.zh: 腳步聲；輪胎胎面；鞋底紋路

examples.en: We heard a heavy tread on the stairs.
examples.zh: 我們聽到樓梯上傳來沉重的腳步聲。

examples.en: The tread of the tire is worn out.
examples.zh: 這個輪胎的胎面已經磨平了。

examples.en: The new shoes have a deep tread for walking on wet roads.
examples.zh: 這雙新鞋的鞋底紋路很深，適合在濕路上行走。

examples.en: The general was accused of treason against his country.
examples.zh: 那位將軍被指控犯了叛國罪。

examples.en: In many countries, treason is a serious crime.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，叛國是一項重罪。

examples.en: The students studied a famous case of treason in history class.
examples.zh: 學生們在歷史課上研讀了一個著名的叛國案例。

examples.en: We felt a small tremor in the classroom this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我們在教室裡感覺到一次小地震。

examples.en: There was a slight tremor in his voice.
examples.zh: 他的聲音裡有一絲顫抖。

examples.en: The old man's hands have a tremor when he holds a cup.
examples.zh: 老先生拿杯子時雙手會發抖。

examples.en: Workers dug a deep trench along the road to lay water pipes.
examples.zh: 工人沿著馬路挖了一條深溝來鋪設水管。

examples.en: The Mariana Trench is the deepest part of the ocean.
examples.zh: 馬里亞納海溝是海洋中最深的地方。

examples.en: The museum displays photographs of soldiers resting in a trench during the war.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了戰爭期間士兵在戰壕中休息的照片。

examples.en: Signs warn people not to trespass on the private farm.
examples.zh: 告示牌警告大家不得擅自闖入這座私人農場。

examples.en: The boys trespassed on the school roof to take photos.
examples.zh: 那些男孩擅自登上學校屋頂拍照。

examples.en: It is illegal to trespass on railway tracks near the station.
examples.zh: 擅自闖入車站附近的鐵軌是違法的。

examples.en: The workers took their case to an employment tribunal.
examples.zh: 工人們把案子提交到勞資審裁庭。

examples.en: A special tribunal will review the complaint next week.
examples.zh: 一個特別審裁會將在下週審查這項申訴。

examples.en: The tribunal ruled that the company had broken the contract.
examples.zh: 法庭裁定該公司違反了合約。

senses.zh: 三人組；三重奏樂團；三件一組

examples.en: The trio performed a short piece at the school concert.
examples.zh: 這個三重奏樂團在學校音樂會上演奏了一首短曲。

examples.en: The trio of friends traveled around Taiwan by train last summer.
examples.zh: 這三位好友去年夏天搭火車環遊台灣。

examples.en: She bought a trio of small plants for her balcony.
examples.zh: 她為自己的陽台買了三盆小植物。

examples.en: The triumphant team waved to the cheering crowd.
examples.zh: 得勝的球隊向歡呼的群眾揮手。

examples.en: She gave a triumphant smile when she saw her test score.
examples.zh: 她看到考試成績時露出得意洋洋的微笑。

examples.en: The students returned home triumphant after winning the contest.
examples.zh: 學生們贏得比賽後凱旋歸來。

examples.en: She pushed the trolley down the aisle of the supermarket.
examples.zh: 她推著購物推車走過超市的走道。

examples.en: The flight attendant brought a trolley full of drinks.
examples.zh: 空服員推來一輛裝滿飲料的推車。

examples.en: We took a trolley from the station to the museum downtown.
examples.zh: 我們從車站搭有軌電車，前往市中心的博物館。

examples.en: The pony began to trot across the green field.
examples.zh: 小馬開始在綠色的田野上小跑。

examples.en: My little brother trotted down the stairs to open the door.
examples.zh: 我弟弟小跑下樓去開門。

examples.en: We trotted to the bus stop so we would not miss the bus.
examples.zh: 我們快步跑到公車站，才不會錯過公車。

examples.en: The horse slowed to a trot near the barn.
examples.zh: 馬在穀倉附近放慢速度，改為小跑。

examples.en: The children set off at a trot toward the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子們小跑著朝遊樂場出發。

examples.en: She went for a short trot around the park before breakfast.
examples.zh: 她在早餐前繞著公園小跑了一小段。

examples.en: The teacher called the parents of the truant.
examples.zh: 老師打電話給那位逃學學生的家長。

examples.en: A truant was found playing games at the arcade.
examples.zh: 有個逃學者被發現在電子遊樂場玩遊戲。

examples.en: Several truants were brought back to school by their parents.
examples.zh: 好幾個逃學的學生被家長帶回了學校。

examples.en: The two countries agreed to a truce during the holiday.
examples.zh: 兩國同意在假期期間休戰。

examples.en: My sister and I called a truce and shared the last cookie.
examples.zh: 我和姊姊決定休戰，一起分享最後一塊餅乾。

examples.en: Leaders hope the truce will lead to lasting peace.
examples.zh: 領袖們希望這次停火能帶來長久的和平。

examples.en: This is truly the best pizza I have ever eaten.
examples.zh: 這真的是我吃過最好吃的披薩。

examples.en: We are truly grateful for your help with the project.
examples.zh: 我們由衷感謝你對這個專案的協助。

examples.en: Is he truly interested in joining the science club?
examples.zh: 他真的有興趣加入科學社嗎？

examples.en: Tuberculosis is a serious disease that mainly affects the lungs.
examples.zh: 結核病是一種主要影響肺部的嚴重疾病。

examples.en: Doctors can treat tuberculosis with medicine taken for several months.
examples.zh: 醫生可以用需服用數個月的藥物來治療結核病。

examples.en: Many countries ran campaigns to reduce tuberculosis a century ago.
examples.zh: 許多國家在一百年前推動活動，以減少結核病。

examples.en: Our class won the tug-of-war on sports day.
examples.zh: 我們班在運動會上贏得了拔河比賽。

examples.en: The two dogs played tug-of-war with an old rope.
examples.zh: 兩隻狗用一條舊繩子玩拔河。

examples.en: There is a tug-of-war between the two departments over the budget.
examples.zh: 兩個部門為了預算展開拉鋸戰。

examples.en: The wind turbine on the hill provides power to the village.
examples.zh: 山丘上的風力渦輪機為村子供電。

examples.en: Engineers repaired the steam turbine at the power plant.
examples.zh: 工程師修理了發電廠的蒸汽渦輪機。

examples.en: Water flows through the turbine to produce electricity.
examples.zh: 水流過渦輪機以產生電力。

senses.zh: 動盪的；湍急的；氣流不穩的

examples.en: The plane shook because of turbulent air over the mountains.
examples.zh: 由於山區上空氣流不穩，飛機搖晃了起來。

examples.en: The country went through a turbulent period in the 1980s.
examples.zh: 這個國家在一九八〇年代經歷了一段動盪的時期。

examples.en: Small boats should avoid the turbulent river after heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，小船應避開湍急的河流。

senses.zh: 營業額；人員流動率；餡餅

examples.en: The shop's annual turnover rose by ten percent.
examples.zh: 這家店的年營業額成長了百分之十。

examples.en: High staff turnover makes it hard to train new workers.
examples.zh: 員工流動率高，讓培訓新人變得很困難。

examples.en: She bought an apple turnover from the bakery.
examples.zh: 她在麵包店買了一個蘋果餡餅。

examples.en: Two-thirds of the students walk to school.
examples.zh: 三分之二的學生走路上學。

examples.en: I have already read two-thirds of this novel.
examples.zh: 我已經讀完這本小說的三分之二了。

examples.en: Two-thirds of the pizza was gone in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 披薩在十分鐘內就被吃掉了三分之二。

examples.en: Typically, the library opens at nine in the morning.
examples.zh: 圖書館通常早上九點開門。

examples.en: Teenagers typically need eight to ten hours of sleep each night.
examples.zh: 青少年通常每晚需要八到十小時睡眠。

examples.en: The tour typically includes lunch at a local restaurant.
examples.zh: 這趟行程通常包含在當地餐廳用午餐。

examples.en: The people hoped to live free from tyranny.
examples.zh: 人民希望能生活在沒有暴政的環境中。

examples.en: The novel describes a society under the tyranny of a single ruler.
examples.zh: 這本小說描寫一個處於單一統治者暴政之下的社會。

examples.en: Some students feel the strict rules are a kind of tyranny.
examples.zh: 有些學生覺得這些嚴格的規定是一種專制。

examples.en: In the story, the king slowly turned into a tyrant.
examples.zh: 在故事中，這位國王漸漸變成了暴君。

examples.en: Many people in the country were afraid of the tyrant.
examples.zh: 國內許多人都很害怕這位專制君主。

examples.en: My boss can be a tyrant when we miss a deadline.
examples.zh: 當我們錯過期限時，我的老闆可能會變得很霸道。

examples.en: The doctor said stress had caused the stomach ulcer.
examples.zh: 醫生說壓力造成了胃潰瘍。

examples.en: He has a painful ulcer in his mouth.
examples.zh: 他的嘴裡有一個很痛的潰瘍。

examples.en: An ulcer can take weeks to heal without proper treatment.
examples.zh: 潰瘍若沒有適當的治療，可能要好幾週才會痊癒。

examples.en: Ultimately, the decision is up to you.
examples.zh: 歸根究柢，這個決定取決於你。

examples.en: He ultimately chose to study engineering instead of law.
examples.zh: 他最後選擇念工程而不是法律。

examples.en: The project ultimately saved the company a lot of money.
examples.zh: 這個專案最終為公司省下了許多錢。

examples.en: Ultraviolet light from the sun can damage your skin.
examples.zh: 來自太陽的紫外線可能會傷害你的皮膚。

examples.en: This lamp uses ultraviolet light to kill germs.
examples.zh: 這盞燈利用紫外線來殺菌。

examples.en: Some insects can see ultraviolet patterns on flowers.
examples.zh: 有些昆蟲能看見花朵上的紫外線圖案。

examples.en: The umpire called the runner out at second base.
examples.zh: 裁判判定跑者在二壘出局。

examples.en: The umpire checked the net before the tennis match began.
examples.zh: 網球比賽開始前，裁判檢查了球網。

examples.en: Both teams accepted the umpire's decision.
examples.zh: 兩隊都接受了裁判的判決。

examples.en: She umpired the softball game at school last Friday.
examples.zh: 她上週五在學校擔任了壘球賽的裁判。

examples.en: My uncle umpires baseball games on weekends.
examples.zh: 我叔叔週末擔任棒球賽的裁判。

examples.en: Who will umpire the final match of the school tournament?
examples.zh: 誰會擔任校內錦標賽決賽的裁判？

examples.en: Cheating on an exam is completely unacceptable.
examples.zh: 考試作弊是完全不可接受的。

examples.en: The hotel room was dirty, which was unacceptable to us.
examples.zh: 飯店房間很髒，這讓我們無法容忍。

examples.en: Loud music after midnight is unacceptable in this building.
examples.zh: 午夜後播放大聲音樂在這棟大樓是不被允許的。

examples.en: The team remained unbeaten throughout the whole season.
examples.zh: 這支球隊整季保持不敗。

examples.en: She is the unbeaten champion of our school's chess club.
examples.zh: 她是我們學校西洋棋社未嘗敗績的冠軍。

examples.en: His unbeaten record of ten wins surprised the coach.
examples.zh: 他十勝的不敗紀錄讓教練很驚訝。

examples.en: There is a lot of uncertainty about next year's budget.
examples.zh: 對於明年的預算還有許多不確定性。

examples.en: She waited for the test results with some uncertainty.
examples.zh: 她心中帶著些許疑慮等待檢驗結果。

examples.en: Economic uncertainty makes many people save more money.
examples.zh: 經濟的不確定性讓許多人存下更多錢。

examples.en: The price of the ticket remained unchanged this year.
examples.zh: 今年的票價維持不變。

examples.en: The recipe has stayed unchanged for over fifty years.
examples.zh: 這份食譜五十多年來一直沒有改變。

examples.en: Her opinion was unchanged after she read the report.
examples.zh: 讀完報告後，她的看法沒有改變。

senses.zh: 是……的基礎；是……的根本原因

examples.en: Good teamwork underlies the success of our school band.
examples.zh: 良好的團隊合作是我們學校樂隊成功的基礎。

examples.en: Several factors underlie the rise in house prices.
examples.zh: 有幾個因素是房價上漲的根本原因。

examples.en: What underlies her fear of speaking in public?
examples.zh: 她害怕公開演講的根本原因是什麼？

examples.en: It is understandable that you feel nervous before the interview.
examples.zh: 你在面試前感到緊張是可以理解的。

examples.en: His anger was understandable after waiting for two hours.
examples.zh: 等了兩個小時之後，他會生氣是情有可原的。

examples.en: The teacher spoke slowly so the story was understandable.
examples.zh: 老師說得很慢，所以這個故事很容易懂。

examples.en: The insurance company agreed to underwrite the new building.
examples.zh: 保險公司同意承保這棟新大樓。

examples.en: A local bank will underwrite the cost of the festival.
examples.zh: 一家本地銀行將承擔這次慶典的費用。

examples.en: Investment banks underwrite new shares before they go on sale.
examples.zh: 投資銀行在新股票開賣前會先負責包銷。

examples.en: Her undoubted talent made her the best singer in school.
examples.zh: 她毫無疑問的才華讓她成為全校最優秀的歌手。

examples.en: The film was an undoubted success at the box office.
examples.zh: 這部電影在票房上無疑是成功的。

examples.en: He is the undoubted leader of our team.
examples.zh: 他是我們團隊公認的領袖。

examples.en: I felt uneasy when I walked home alone at night.
examples.zh: 我晚上獨自走路回家時覺得不安。

examples.en: He gave an uneasy laugh when the teacher called his name.
examples.zh: 老師叫到他的名字時，他不自在地笑了一下。

examples.en: There was an uneasy silence after the manager's announcement.
examples.zh: 經理宣布之後，出現了一陣令人不安的沉默。

examples.en: My cousin has been unemployed since the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，我表哥就一直失業。

examples.en: She is looking for work because she is unemployed.
examples.zh: 她因為失業而在找工作。

examples.en: Many unemployed workers attended the job fair.
examples.zh: 許多失業的工人參加了就業博覽會。

examples.en: Astronomers noticed an unidentified object in the sky.
examples.zh: 天文學家注意到天空中有一個不明物體。

examples.en: The package was left by an unidentified man.
examples.zh: 這個包裹是由一名身分不明的男子留下的。

examples.en: An unidentified caller left a message at the office.
examples.zh: 一名身分不明的來電者在辦公室留了訊息。

examples.en: The coach hopes to unleash the full potential of the team.
examples.zh: 教練希望釋放這支球隊的全部潛力。

examples.en: The announcement unleashed a wave of excitement among fans.
examples.zh: 這項宣布在粉絲之間引發了一股興奮的浪潮。

examples.en: Do not unleash your dog near the playground.
examples.zh: 請不要在遊樂場附近解開你的狗的牽繩。

examples.en: Workers unloaded boxes from the truck in front of the store.
examples.zh: 工人在店門口把箱子從貨車上卸下來。

examples.en: Let me unload the shopping bags from the car before we go inside.
examples.zh: 進去之前，讓我先把購物袋從車上卸下來。

examples.en: The ship will unload its cargo at the port tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 這艘船明天早上會在港口卸貨。

examples.en: We unpacked our suitcases as soon as we reached the hotel.
examples.zh: 一到飯店，我們就把行李箱裡的東西拿出來整理。

examples.en: She helped her mom unpack the groceries.
examples.zh: 她幫媽媽把採買回來的東西拿出來。

examples.en: It took us a week to unpack all the boxes in the new house.
examples.zh: 我們花了一週才把新家所有的箱子拆開整理完。

examples.en: Social unrest grew as food prices kept rising.
examples.zh: 隨著食品價格持續上漲，社會動亂加劇了。

examples.en: The news report said unrest in the region has ended.
examples.zh: 新聞報導說，該地區的動亂已經結束。

examples.en: There was unrest among the workers about the new schedule.
examples.zh: 員工們對新的排班表出現了不滿情緒。

examples.en: It was unusually cold for a day in April.
examples.zh: 以四月的天氣來說，那天異常寒冷。

examples.en: The students were unusually quiet during the class.
examples.zh: 學生們上課時異常安靜。

examples.en: She arrived unusually early at the office this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上格外早到辦公室。

examples.en: I gave my unwanted clothes to a charity shop.
examples.zh: 我把不要的衣服捐給了慈善二手店。

examples.en: Delete unwanted emails to keep your inbox tidy.
examples.zh: 刪除不想要的電子郵件，讓你的收件匣保持整齊。

examples.en: He felt unwanted at the party because nobody talked to him.
examples.zh: 他在派對上覺得不受歡迎，因為沒有人跟他說話。

examples.en: Please keep your contact information up-to-date so we can reach you easily.
examples.zh: 請讓你的聯絡資訊保持最新，方便我們與你聯繫。

examples.en: The museum has an up-to-date guide for visitors.
examples.zh: 博物館有一份最新的參觀導覽。

examples.en: The company uses up-to-date machines in its factory.
examples.zh: 這家公司在工廠裡使用最新式的機器。

examples.en: He had a strict upbringing in a small town.
examples.zh: 他在小鎮上受到嚴格的教養。

examples.en: Her upbringing taught her to respect older people.
examples.zh: 她所受的教養讓她懂得尊敬長輩。

examples.en: Parents play a major role in a child's upbringing.
examples.zh: 父母在孩子的養育過程中扮演重要的角色。

examples.en: Teachers must uphold the rules of the school.
examples.zh: 老師必須維護學校的規定。

examples.en: The court decided to uphold the earlier decision.
examples.zh: 法院決定維持先前的判決。

examples.en: We should uphold our promise to the customers.
examples.zh: 我們應該堅守對顧客的承諾。

examples.en: Uranium is a heavy metal used to produce nuclear energy.
examples.zh: 鈾是一種用來產生核能的重金屬。

examples.en: The country imports uranium for its power plants.
examples.zh: 這個國家為了發電廠而進口鈾。

examples.en: Scientists measured the amount of uranium in the rock.
examples.zh: 科學家測量了岩石中鈾的含量。

examples.en: The doctor asked for a urine sample.
examples.zh: 醫生要求採集尿液檢體。

examples.en: Healthy urine is usually pale yellow when a person is well hydrated.
examples.zh: 水分攝取充足時，健康的尿液通常呈淡黃色。

examples.en: A urine test can show whether you are drinking enough water.
examples.zh: 尿液檢驗可以顯示你是否喝了足夠的水。

examples.en: This matter is of the utmost importance to our company.
examples.zh: 這件事對我們公司來說極為重要。

examples.en: She handled the glass vase with the utmost care.
examples.zh: 她極為小心地拿著那個玻璃花瓶。

examples.en: Safety is our utmost concern when we travel with children.
examples.zh: 帶孩子旅行時，安全是我們最優先的考量。

examples.en: We did our utmost to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 我們盡了最大的努力準時完成專案。

examples.en: He tried his utmost to help the new student.
examples.zh: 他盡全力幫助那位新同學。

examples.en: The team worked to the utmost of its ability.
examples.zh: 團隊竭盡所能地工作。

examples.en: The firefighter made a valiant effort to save the cat.
examples.zh: 消防員英勇地努力救出那隻貓。

examples.en: Despite a valiant try, our team lost the match.
examples.zh: 儘管奮勇嘗試，我們的隊伍還是輸了比賽。

examples.en: The valiant young girl helped her neighbor in the storm.
examples.zh: 這位勇敢的小女孩在暴風雨中幫助了鄰居。

examples.en: The validity of this ticket ends on Friday.
examples.zh: 這張票的有效期限到週五截止。

examples.en: Scientists questioned the validity of the survey results.
examples.zh: 科學家質疑這項調查結果的正確性。

examples.en: Please check the validity of your passport before you travel.
examples.zh: 旅行前請確認你的護照是否仍然有效。

examples.en: Turn the valve to stop the water flow.
examples.zh: 轉動閥門來停止水流。

examples.en: The plumber replaced a broken valve under the sink.
examples.zh: 水電工更換了水槽下方壞掉的閥門。

examples.en: The heart valve controls the flow of blood.
examples.zh: 心臟瓣膜控制著血液的流動。

examples.en: The menu offers a varied selection of vegetarian dishes.
examples.zh: 菜單提供各式各樣的素食料理。

examples.en: She has a varied career as a teacher and writer.
examples.zh: 她的職涯很多樣，當過老師也當過作家。

examples.en: Their interests are quite varied, from music to science.
examples.zh: 他們的興趣相當多元，從音樂到科學都有。

examples.en: The island is covered with thick green vegetation.
examples.zh: 這座島被濃密的綠色植物覆蓋。

examples.en: Heavy rain helps the vegetation grow along the river.
examples.zh: 大雨有助於河岸的植被生長。

examples.en: We studied the local vegetation in our science class.
examples.zh: 我們在自然課上研究了當地的植被。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to calculate the velocity of the car.
examples.zh: 老師要我們計算這輛車的速度。

examples.en: Wind velocity increased sharply before the storm arrived.
examples.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，風速急遽增加。

examples.en: The ball hit the wall at a high velocity.
examples.zh: 球以很高的速度撞上了牆。

examples.en: Street sellers vend snacks outside the night market.
examples.zh: 小販在夜市外頭販賣小吃。

examples.en: The shop is licensed to vend tickets for the concert.
examples.zh: 這家店獲准販售演唱會門票。

examples.en: Machines in the hall vend drinks and light meals.
examples.zh: 大廳裡的機器販售飲料和輕食。

examples.en: Warm air came out of the vent near the window.
examples.zh: 暖氣從窗邊的通風口吹出來。

examples.en: The kitchen vent removes smoke while we cook.
examples.zh: 廚房的通風口會在我們煮菜時排出油煙。

examples.en: Please keep the vent clear so air can pass through.
examples.zh: 請保持通風口暢通，讓空氣流通。

examples.en: She called her friend to vent her anger after the meeting.
examples.zh: 開完會後，她打電話給朋友宣洩怒氣。

examples.en: Some students vent their stress by playing sports.
examples.zh: 有些學生靠運動來宣洩壓力。

examples.en: It is better to vent your feelings than to hide them.
examples.zh: 與其隱藏情緒，不如把感受宣洩出來。

examples.en: Please open the windows to ventilate the classroom.
examples.zh: 請打開窗戶讓教室通風。

examples.en: The kitchen is well ventilated by a large fan.
examples.zh: 廚房有一台大風扇，通風良好。

examples.en: We must ventilate the room after painting the walls.
examples.zh: 粉刷牆壁後，我們必須讓房間通風。

examples.en: The old farmhouse stood on the verge of the forest.
examples.zh: 那棟老農舍位於森林的邊緣。

examples.en: The company is on the verge of closing its store.
examples.zh: 這家公司眼看就要關閉店面了。

examples.en: Wild flowers grew along the verge of the road.
examples.zh: 野花沿著路邊生長。

examples.en: Please verify your email address before you log in.
examples.zh: 登入前請先確認您的電子郵件地址。

examples.en: The clerk asked me to verify my phone number.
examples.zh: 店員請我核對我的電話號碼。

examples.en: Scientists need to verify the results with more tests.
examples.zh: 科學家需要用更多實驗來證實結果。

examples.en: The vicar welcomed everyone to the village church.
examples.zh: 教區牧師歡迎大家來到村裡的教堂。

examples.en: Our vicar gives a short talk every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 我們的教區牧師每週日早上都會做簡短的講道。

examples.en: The villagers asked the vicar to help with the charity sale.
examples.zh: 村民請教區牧師協助義賣活動。

examples.en: There is a good bakery in the vicinity of our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校附近有一家不錯的麵包店。

examples.en: Few hotels in the vicinity offer free breakfast.
examples.zh: 附近很少有旅館提供免費早餐。

examples.en: Police asked people in the vicinity to stay home.
examples.zh: 警方請附近的居民留在家中。

examples.en: Online scammers often victimize elderly people.
examples.zh: 網路詐騙集團常常讓年長者受害。

examples.en: The school has a rule against anyone who tries to victimize new students.
examples.zh: 學校規定不准任何人欺負新生。

examples.en: Shoppers should be careful not to be victimized by fake websites.
examples.zh: 購物時要小心，不要被假網站所騙。

examples.en: Our team was victorious in the final game.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍在決賽中獲勝。

examples.en: The victorious players held up the trophy.
examples.zh: 獲勝的球員高舉獎盃。

examples.en: She felt victorious after finishing the long race.
examples.zh: 跑完這場漫長的比賽後，她覺得自己是勝利者。

examples.en: Every villager came to the festival in the square.
examples.zh: 每位村民都來參加廣場上的慶典。

examples.en: The villagers share water from a well near the temple.
examples.zh: 村民共用廟旁一口井的水。

examples.en: A friendly villager showed us the way to the farm.
examples.zh: 一位友善的村民為我們指引了去農場的路。

examples.en: She bought a vintage dress at the flea market.
examples.zh: 她在跳蚤市場買了一件復古洋裝。

examples.en: My uncle drives a vintage car from the 1960s.
examples.zh: 我叔叔開一輛六〇年代的老爺車。

examples.en: The cafe is decorated with vintage posters and old lamps.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡店用復古海報和舊燈具佈置。

senses.zh: 釀酒葡萄的收成年份；特定年份的葡萄酒

examples.en: This wine is from an excellent vintage.
examples.zh: 這瓶酒來自一個很棒的年份。

examples.en: The vintage of the bottle is printed on the label.
examples.zh: 酒瓶的年份印在標籤上。

examples.en: Experts say the 2015 vintage was the best in ten years.
examples.zh: 專家說二〇一五年份的酒是十年來最好的。

examples.en: The floor is covered with easy-to-clean vinyl.
examples.zh: 地板上鋪著容易清潔的乙烯基塑膠。

examples.en: My father still listens to music on vinyl instead of streaming it.
examples.zh: 我爸爸仍用黑膠唱片聽音樂，而不是串流播放。

examples.en: The bag is made of vinyl, so it keeps the rain out.
examples.zh: 這個袋子是乙烯基塑膠做的，所以可以防雨。

examples.en: The park is virtually empty on weekday mornings.
examples.zh: 平日早上公園幾乎沒有人。

examples.en: The two phones are virtually the same in price.
examples.zh: 這兩支手機的價格幾乎一樣。

examples.en: Students can visit the museum virtually from home.
examples.zh: 學生在家就能以虛擬方式參觀博物館。

examples.en: Try to visualize the story as you read it.
examples.zh: 閱讀時試著在腦海中想像故事的畫面。

examples.en: Charts help us visualize the data more clearly.
examples.zh: 圖表幫助我們更清楚地看見資料。

examples.en: I can visualize myself standing on the stage.
examples.zh: 我能想像自己站在舞台上的樣子。

examples.en: Short skirts were in vogue that summer.
examples.zh: 那年夏天短裙很流行。

examples.en: Wearing large hats is back in vogue this year.
examples.zh: 今年戴大帽子又開始流行了。

examples.en: Her style went out of vogue many years ago.
examples.zh: 她的風格許多年前就不流行了。

examples.en: The empty chair left a void in the family.
examples.zh: 那張空椅子在家中留下了一片空虛。

examples.en: Stars shine in the dark void of space.
examples.zh: 星星在黑暗空曠的太空中閃耀。

examples.en: Nothing could fill the void after his best friend moved away.
examples.zh: 最好的朋友搬走後，沒有什麼能填補他心中的空缺。

examples.en: The contract is void if both sides do not sign it.
examples.zh: 如果雙方沒有簽名，這份合約就無效。

examples.en: This ticket is void after the date printed on it.
examples.zh: 這張票過了印在上面的日期就無效。

examples.en: The judge said the agreement was null and void.
examples.zh: 法官說這項協議無效。

examples.en: The price of oil has been volatile this year.
examples.zh: 今年的油價一直起伏不定。

examples.en: Alcohol is a volatile liquid that evaporates quickly.
examples.zh: 酒精是一種容易揮發的液體。

examples.en: He has a volatile temper, so we try not to upset him.
examples.zh: 他的脾氣很不穩定，所以我們盡量不惹他不高興。

examples.en: A typical AA alkaline battery provides about one and a half volts.
examples.zh: 一般的 AA 鹼性電池大約提供一點五伏特的電壓。

examples.en: This charger works at 110 volts.
examples.zh: 這個充電器在一百一十伏特下運作。

examples.en: The teacher measured six volts across the battery with a small meter.
examples.zh: 老師用小型電表量得電池兩端的電壓為六伏特。

examples.en: High voltage can be dangerous, so keep away from the wires.
examples.zh: 高電壓可能很危險，所以請遠離電線。

examples.en: Household outlets in Taiwan commonly supply a voltage of 110 or 220 volts.
examples.zh: 台灣家用插座常供應一百一十或二百二十伏特的電壓。

examples.en: A drop in voltage made the lights flicker.
examples.zh: 電壓下降讓燈光閃爍。

examples.en: He was embarrassed by his friend's vulgar jokes.
examples.zh: 他對朋友的粗俗笑話感到尷尬。

examples.en: The teacher asked the class not to use vulgar language.
examples.zh: 老師要求全班不要使用粗俗的言語。

examples.en: The restaurant's decoration looked bright but vulgar.
examples.zh: 那家餐廳的裝潢看起來很鮮豔，卻很俗氣。

examples.en: The children wade into the shallow stream to catch fish.
examples.zh: 孩子們蹚進淺溪裡抓魚。

examples.en: We had to wade across the river to reach the camp.
examples.zh: 我們得涉水過河才能到達營地。

examples.en: After the typhoon, people waded through the flooded street.
examples.zh: 颱風過後，人們蹚過淹水的街道。

examples.en: The baby began to wail when his mother left the room.
examples.zh: 媽媽離開房間時，嬰兒開始嚎啕大哭。

examples.en: Sirens wailed in the distance all night.
examples.zh: 警笛整晚在遠處呼嘯。

examples.en: The little girl wailed because she lost her toy.
examples.zh: 小女孩因為弄丟玩具而哭得很大聲。

examples.en: A loud wail came from the next room.
examples.zh: 隔壁房間傳來一聲響亮的哀號。

examples.en: We heard the wail of a siren outside.
examples.zh: 我們聽到外面傳來警笛的哀鳴。

examples.en: The child let out a wail when he fell down.
examples.zh: 那個孩子跌倒時發出一聲哀號。

examples.en: We chose light blue wallpaper for the bedroom.
examples.zh: 我們為臥室挑了淺藍色的壁紙。

examples.en: She changed the wallpaper on her phone to a photo of her dog.
examples.zh: 她把手機桌布換成她的狗的照片。

examples.en: The old wallpaper began to peel off the wall.
examples.zh: 舊壁紙開始從牆上剝落。

examples.en: They plan to wallpaper the living room this weekend.
examples.zh: 他們打算這個週末幫客廳貼壁紙。

examples.en: My parents wallpapered the hallway themselves to save money on decorating.
examples.zh: 我爸媽為了節省裝潢費，自己幫走廊貼了壁紙。

examples.en: It took us a whole day to wallpaper the small room.
examples.zh: 我們花了一整天才把那間小房間貼好壁紙。

examples.en: The shop sells kitchenware and other household ware.
examples.zh: 這家店販售廚房用品和其他家用器皿。

examples.en: The vendor laid out his wares on a cloth.
examples.zh: 小販把自己的商品攤放在一塊布上。

examples.en: Ceramic ware made in this town is famous around the world.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮製作的陶瓷器皿聞名全世界。

examples.en: The two warring sides finally agreed to talk.
examples.zh: 交戰的雙方終於同意談判。

examples.en: The history teacher explained why the warring states fought.
examples.zh: 歷史老師說明了交戰各國為何開戰。

examples.en: Aid workers delivered food to families caught between the warring sides.
examples.zh: 救援人員把食物送給受困於交戰雙方之間的家庭。

examples.en: Food was hard to find in wartime.
examples.zh: 戰時很難找到食物。

examples.en: My grandmother often tells stories about wartime.
examples.zh: 我奶奶常常說起戰爭時期的故事。

examples.en: The museum shows letters written during wartime.
examples.zh: 博物館展出戰時寫的信件。

examples.en: The boat has a watertight cover to keep supplies dry.
examples.zh: 這艘船有防水的蓋子，能讓補給品保持乾燥。

examples.en: This watertight bag is perfect for the beach.
examples.zh: 這個防水袋很適合帶去海邊。

examples.en: The lawyer presented a watertight argument in court.
examples.zh: 律師在法庭上提出了無懈可擊的論點。

examples.en: This light bulb uses only ten watts of power.
examples.zh: 這顆燈泡的耗電功率只有十瓦。

examples.en: The microwave is rated at 800 watts.
examples.zh: 這台微波爐的額定功率是八百瓦。

examples.en: At full power, a heater rated at more watts uses more energy per second.
examples.zh: 全功率運轉時，額定瓦數較高的暖爐每秒消耗的電能較多。

examples.en: Her way-out outfit made everyone look twice.
examples.zh: 她古怪的打扮讓每個人都多看了兩眼。

examples.en: The designer is known for his way-out ideas.
examples.zh: 這位設計師以他前衛的點子聞名。

examples.en: Some people thought the film was too way-out for kids.
examples.zh: 有些人認為這部電影對孩子來說太古怪了。

senses.zh: 弱點；虛弱；難以抗拒的喜好

examples.en: Shyness is his biggest weakness at work.
examples.zh: 害羞是他工作上最大的弱點。

examples.en: Illness left her with a feeling of weakness.
examples.zh: 生病讓她感到虛弱無力。

examples.en: Everyone has a weakness, and mine is chocolate.
examples.zh: 每個人都有弱點，而我的弱點是巧克力。

examples.en: He put a wedge under the door to keep it open.
examples.zh: 他在門下塞了一個楔子讓門保持敞開。

examples.en: She cut the cake into six wedges.
examples.zh: 她把蛋糕切成六個楔形小塊。

examples.en: The cheese was served in small wedges.
examples.zh: 起司被切成小楔形後端上桌。

examples.en: He wedged a book under the table leg.
examples.zh: 他把一本書塞在桌腳下。

examples.en: She wedged her bag between two boxes.
examples.zh: 她把包包塞進兩個箱子之間。

examples.en: The crowd wedged us into a corner of the train.
examples.zh: 擁擠的人群把我們擠進車廂的角落。

examples.en: The wee kitten fell asleep in her hand.
examples.zh: 那隻小小的小貓在她手裡睡著了。

examples.en: It was a wee village with only ten houses.
examples.zh: 那是一個只有十戶人家的小村莊。

examples.en: He gave me a wee piece of cake.
examples.zh: 他給了我一小塊蛋糕。

examples.en: Workers weld the steel pipes together at the factory.
examples.zh: 工人在工廠裡把鋼管焊接在一起。

examples.en: He learned how to weld in a vocational school.
examples.zh: 他在職業學校學會了焊接。

examples.en: The bicycle frame was welded by hand.
examples.zh: 這輛腳踏車的車架是手工焊接的。

examples.en: The weld on the metal gate is very strong.
examples.zh: 金屬大門上的焊接處非常牢固。

examples.en: The inspector checked each weld for cracks.
examples.zh: 檢查員逐一檢查每道焊縫有沒有裂痕。

examples.en: A crack appeared along the weld.
examples.zh: 焊縫上出現了一道裂痕。

examples.en: Regular exercise is good for your well-being.
examples.zh: 規律運動對你的身心健康有益。

examples.en: The teacher cares about the well-being of every student.
examples.zh: 老師很在乎每位學生的福祉。

examples.en: Sleep plays a big role in our well-being.
examples.zh: 睡眠對我們的身心安適有重要影響。

examples.en: The school has a system whereby students can borrow laptops.
examples.zh: 學校有一套制度，學生可以憑此借用筆記型電腦。

examples.en: They made a plan whereby everyone shares the cost.
examples.zh: 他們擬定了一個辦法，讓每個人分攤費用。

examples.en: The club introduced a rule whereby members must sign in.
examples.zh: 社團制定了一條規則，要求成員必須簽到。

examples.en: She read a magazine whilst waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 她等公車時看了一本雜誌。

examples.en: Whilst I enjoy cooking, I do not like washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 我雖然喜歡下廚，卻不喜歡洗碗。

examples.en: Please keep your phone off whilst the film is playing.
examples.zh: 電影播放期間請將手機關機。

examples.en: Leaves whirled in the wind outside the school gate.
examples.zh: 樹葉在校門外的風中打轉。

examples.en: The dancers whirled around the room as the music grew faster.
examples.zh: 隨著音樂加快，舞者們在房間裡旋轉。

examples.en: My head whirled after the long ride.
examples.zh: 搭了那段長途車之後，我頭昏眼花。

examples.en: The skater did a whirl on the ice.
examples.zh: 溜冰選手在冰上轉了一圈。

examples.en: The week before the exam was a whirl of studying.
examples.zh: 考試前的那一週是一陣讀書的忙亂。

examples.en: Let's give the new game a whirl.
examples.zh: 我們來試玩看看這個新遊戲吧。

examples.en: She used a whisk to mix the eggs and milk.
examples.zh: 她用打蛋器把雞蛋和牛奶拌勻。

examples.en: A metal whisk hangs on the kitchen wall.
examples.zh: 一支金屬打蛋器掛在廚房牆上。

examples.en: Please wash the whisk after you finish baking.
examples.zh: 烘焙完請把打蛋器洗乾淨。

examples.en: Whisk the eggs until they are light and fluffy.
examples.zh: 把蛋打到變得蓬鬆輕盈。

examples.en: The waiter whisked away our empty plates.
examples.zh: 服務生迅速收走了我們的空盤子。

examples.en: A taxi whisked us to the airport in twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 一輛計程車二十分鐘就把我們送到機場。

examples.en: The widower lives alone in a small apartment.
examples.zh: 那位鰥夫獨自住在一間小公寓。

examples.en: Neighbors often bring food to the old widower.
examples.zh: 鄰居常常送食物給那位年長的鰥夫。

examples.en: He became a widower at the age of sixty.
examples.zh: 他六十歲時成了鰥夫。

examples.en: The winger passed the ball to the striker.
examples.zh: 邊鋒把球傳給前鋒。

examples.en: Our school's best winger is very fast.
examples.zh: 我們學校最好的邊鋒跑得非常快。

examples.en: The coach moved him from midfield to winger.
examples.zh: 教練把他從中場調到邊鋒。

examples.en: The winning team received a gold cup.
examples.zh: 獲勝的隊伍得到一座金杯。

examples.en: She scored the winning goal in the last minute.
examples.zh: 她在最後一分鐘踢進了致勝的一球。

examples.en: The little boy has a winning smile.
examples.zh: 那個小男孩有迷人的笑容。

examples.en: He spent his winnings on a new bicycle.
examples.zh: 他把贏得的獎金拿去買一輛新腳踏車。

examples.en: The winnings were shared among the whole team.
examples.zh: 獎金分給了全隊成員。

examples.en: Her winnings from the contest paid for the trip.
examples.zh: 她比賽贏得的獎金付了這趟旅行的費用。

examples.en: You can make a cash withdrawal at the ATM.
examples.zh: 你可以在自動提款機提領現金。

examples.en: The doctor explained that suddenly stopping some medicines can cause withdrawal symptoms.
examples.zh: 醫師說明，突然停用某些藥物可能引起戒斷症狀。

examples.en: His withdrawal from the club surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 他退出社團讓大家很驚訝。

examples.en: The bridge was built to withstand strong typhoons.
examples.zh: 這座橋的設計能承受強烈颱風。

examples.en: These boots can withstand heavy rain and mud.
examples.zh: 這雙靴子經得起大雨和泥濘。

examples.en: Few small shops can withstand such high rent.
examples.zh: 很少有小商店撐得住這麼高的租金。

examples.en: Many shops woo customers with big discounts.
examples.zh: 許多商店用大折扣來爭取顧客。

examples.en: He tried to woo her with flowers and letters.
examples.zh: 他試著用花和信件追求她。

examples.en: The city hopes to woo more tourists this summer.
examples.zh: 這座城市希望今年夏天吸引更多遊客。

examples.en: We went for a walk in the woodland behind the village.
examples.zh: 我們到村子後面的林地散步。

examples.en: Many birds live in the woodland near the lake.
examples.zh: 許多鳥類棲息在湖邊的樹林裡。

examples.en: The woodland path was covered with fallen leaves.
examples.zh: 林間小徑鋪滿了落葉。

senses.zh: 體力或技術工人（通常指男性）

examples.en: A workman came to fix the water pipe.
examples.zh: 一位工人來修水管。

examples.en: The workmen are painting the school fence.
examples.zh: 工人們正在粉刷學校的圍籬。

examples.en: He is a skilled workman who takes pride in his work.
examples.zh: 他是個技術純熟的工匠，對自己的工作感到自豪。

examples.en: The weather will worsen in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午天氣會轉壞。

examples.en: Lack of sleep can worsen your headache.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足會讓你的頭痛更嚴重。

examples.en: The traffic worsened after the heavy rain started.
examples.zh: 大雨開始下之後，交通變得更糟。

examples.en: The would-be singer practiced every night after school.
examples.zh: 那位想成為歌手的人每天放學後都練習。

examples.en: Many would-be buyers came to see the house.
examples.zh: 許多有意購屋的人來看這間房子。

examples.en: A would-be author gave me a copy of his story.
examples.zh: 一位想當作家的人給了我一份他的故事。

examples.en: She hung a green wreath on the front door.
examples.zh: 她在前門掛了一個綠色花環。

examples.en: Visitors laid a wreath at the memorial.
examples.zh: 訪客在紀念碑前獻上花圈。

examples.en: The wreath was made of pine branches and red ribbons.
examples.zh: 這個花環是用松枝和紅色緞帶做成的。

examples.en: Dad used a wrench to tighten the bolt.
examples.zh: 爸爸用扳手鎖緊螺栓。

examples.en: Please pass me the wrench from the toolbox.
examples.zh: 請把工具箱裡的扳手遞給我。

examples.en: The wrench in his ankle kept him off the field for a week.
examples.zh: 他腳踝的扭傷讓他一個星期不能上場。

examples.en: He wrenched the door open with both hands.
examples.zh: 他用雙手猛力把門扭開。

examples.en: She wrenched her knee during the hike.
examples.zh: 她在健行時扭傷了膝蓋。

examples.en: The wind wrenched the umbrella out of my hand.
examples.zh: 風把雨傘從我手中猛地扯走。

examples.en: The lost puppy looked cold and wretched in the rain.
examples.zh: 那隻走失的小狗在雨中看起來又冷又可憐。

examples.en: I had a wretched cold and stayed home all week.
examples.zh: 我得了很嚴重的感冒，整個星期都待在家。

examples.en: The wretched weather ruined our picnic plans.
examples.zh: 糟糕的天氣毀了我們的野餐計畫。

examples.en: Please wring the towel before you hang it up.
examples.zh: 把毛巾掛起來之前，請先擰乾。

examples.en: He wrung his hands nervously while waiting for the results.
examples.zh: 等待結果時，他緊張地絞著雙手。

examples.en: She wrung out her wet socks over the sink.
examples.zh: 她在水槽上方把濕襪子擰乾。

senses.zh: 紗線（含毛線）；故事（常指誇張的敘述）

examples.en: Grandma bought blue yarn to knit a scarf.
examples.zh: 奶奶買了藍色毛線來織圍巾。

examples.en: The cat played with a ball of yarn on the floor.
examples.zh: 貓在地板上玩一團毛線。

examples.en: My uncle likes to spin a yarn about his fishing trips.
examples.zh: 我叔叔喜歡講他釣魚旅行的故事。

examples.en: Bakers add yeast to make the dough rise.
examples.zh: 烘焙師傅加入酵母讓麵團發起來。

examples.en: We ran out of yeast, so we could not bake bread.
examples.zh: 我們的酵母用完了，所以沒辦法烤麵包。

examples.en: Yeast is a tiny living thing that feeds on sugar.
examples.zh: 酵母是一種以糖為食的微小生物。

examples.en: This souvenir costs about two thousand yen.
examples.zh: 這件紀念品大約要兩千日圓。

examples.en: I exchanged some dollars for yen at the airport.
examples.zh: 我在機場把一些美元換成日圓。

examples.en: She has a yen to travel around the world.
examples.zh: 她很渴望環遊世界。

examples.en: The farmer put a yoke on the ox before plowing.
examples.zh: 農夫在耕田前把軛套在牛身上。

examples.en: The old yoke hung on the barn wall.
examples.zh: 那副舊軛掛在穀倉的牆上。

examples.en: The people finally freed themselves from the yoke of debt.
examples.zh: 人們終於擺脫了債務的束縛。

senses.zh: 噁心的；難吃的；髒兮兮的

examples.en: The soup tasted yucky, so I left it.
examples.zh: 這碗湯嚐起來很難吃，所以我把它擱在一旁。

examples.en: There is yucky mud all over my shoes.
examples.zh: 我的鞋子上沾滿了髒兮兮的泥巴。

examples.en: The kids said the cough medicine was yucky.
examples.zh: 孩子們說這種咳嗽藥很噁心。

examples.en: She studies English with great zeal to prepare for her exchange year.
examples.zh: 她滿懷熱忱地學英文，為出國交換的一年做準備。

examples.en: The new coach is full of zeal for the team.
examples.zh: 新教練對球隊充滿熱忱。

examples.en: Their zeal for the project impressed the manager.
examples.zh: 他們對這個專案的熱忱讓經理印象深刻。

examples.en: Zinc is a metal that protects iron from rust.
examples.zh: 鋅是一種能保護鐵不生鏽的金屬。

examples.en: The doctor said I need more zinc in my diet.
examples.zh: 醫生說我的飲食需要多攝取鋅。

examples.en: The roof of the old barn is covered with zinc.
examples.zh: 那間舊穀倉的屋頂鋪著鋅板。

examples.en: Please zip your jacket because it is cold outside.
examples.zh: 外面很冷，請把外套的拉鍊拉上。

examples.en: A red car zipped past us on the highway.
examples.zh: 一輛紅色汽車在高速公路上從我們身旁呼嘯而過。

examples.en: She zipped her bag and ran to the bus stop.
examples.zh: 她拉上袋子的拉鍊，跑向公車站。

examples.en: The zip on my backpack is broken.
examples.zh: 我背包的拉鍊壞了。

examples.en: Please write your zip code on the envelope.
examples.zh: 請在信封上寫下你的郵遞區號。

examples.en: He fixed the zip on his coat with a pin.
examples.zh: 他用別針修好了外套的拉鍊。

examples.en: The baby has chubby cheeks and a big smile.
examples.zh: 這個寶寶有圓滾滾的臉頰和燦爛的笑容。

examples.en: My neighbor's chubby cat sleeps all day on the sofa.
examples.zh: 鄰居那隻圓滾滾的貓整天都睡在沙發上。

examples.en: He was a chubby boy, but he loved to run.
examples.zh: 他以前是個圓胖的男孩，但很愛跑步。

examples.en: The journalist interviewed the mayor about the new bridge.
examples.zh: 記者就新橋採訪了市長。

examples.en: My sister wants to become a journalist after college.
examples.zh: 我姊姊大學畢業後想當記者。

examples.en: A good journalist checks the facts before writing a story.
examples.zh: 好的記者會在寫報導前先查證事實。

examples.en: Please underline the key words in the passage.
examples.zh: 請在這段文章中的關鍵字下面畫線。

examples.en: The teacher underlined the title with a red pen.
examples.zh: 老師用紅筆在標題下面畫線。

examples.en: The report underlines the need for more bus routes.
examples.zh: 這份報告強調需要增加公車路線。

examples.en: Use an underline to show the important words.
examples.zh: 請用底線標示重要的字。

examples.en: There is a red underline below the misspelled word.
examples.zh: 拼錯的字下面有一條紅色底線。

examples.en: The underline in the heading is hard to see.
examples.zh: 標題中的底線很難看清楚。

examples.en: The street vendor sells hot sweet potatoes every winter.
examples.zh: 那位街頭小販每年冬天都賣熱地瓜。

examples.en: Our school chose a new vendor for the lunch boxes.
examples.zh: 我們學校為便當選了新的供應商。

examples.en: Each vendor at the market has a small stall.
examples.zh: 市集裡每個攤販都有一個小攤位。

examples.en: Add a little vinegar to the salad dressing.
examples.zh: 在沙拉醬裡加一點醋。

examples.en: This bottle of vinegar is made from rice.
examples.zh: 這瓶醋是用米做的。

examples.en: Mom cleaned the window with water and vinegar.
examples.zh: 媽媽用水和醋擦窗戶。

examples.en: It was considerate of you to call before coming over.
examples.zh: 你來之前先打電話，真是體貼。

examples.en: A considerate neighbor keeps the music quiet at night.
examples.zh: 體貼的鄰居晚上會把音樂開小聲。

examples.en: She is always considerate toward new classmates.
examples.zh: 她對新同學總是很體貼。

examples.en: Please sign the document at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 請在這份文件的頁面底部簽名。

examples.en: I saved the document on my computer.
examples.zh: 我把這份檔案存在電腦裡。

examples.en: You need to bring an official document to the bank.
examples.zh: 你需要帶一份正式文件去銀行。

examples.en: The students documented the changes in the weather.
examples.zh: 學生們記錄了天氣的變化。

examples.en: The nurse documented every visit in the patient's file.
examples.zh: 護士把每次看診都記錄在病人的檔案裡。

examples.en: Applicants must document their work experience with letters from previous employers.
examples.zh: 應徵者必須提供前雇主的信函，證明自己的工作經驗。

examples.en: You can purchase tickets online or at the station.
examples.zh: 你可以在網路上或車站購買車票。

examples.en: She purchased a new laptop for school.
examples.zh: 她買了一台新筆電供自己上學時使用。

examples.en: We purchased the sofa at a big discount.
examples.zh: 我們以很大的折扣買了這張沙發。

examples.en: Keep your receipt as proof of purchase.
examples.zh: 請保留收據作為購買證明。

examples.en: His latest purchase was a pair of running shoes.
examples.zh: 他最近買的東西是一雙跑鞋。

examples.en: The purchase of the house took three months.
examples.zh: 購買這棟房子花了三個月的時間。

examples.en: The doctor found an abnormal result in the blood test.
examples.zh: 醫生在血液檢查中發現了異常的結果。

examples.en: It is abnormal for the weather to be this hot in March.
examples.zh: 三月的天氣這麼熱是反常的。

examples.en: The machine made an abnormal noise before it stopped.
examples.zh: 機器在停止前發出了不正常的聲音。

examples.en: The abuse of power can harm a whole company.
examples.zh: 濫用權力可能傷害整間公司。

examples.en: The law protects children from abuse.
examples.zh: 法律保護兒童免受虐待。

examples.en: Drug abuse is a serious problem for many families.
examples.zh: 藥物濫用對許多家庭來說是個嚴重的問題。

examples.en: Some people abuse the free Wi-Fi at the library.
examples.zh: 有些人濫用圖書館的免費無線網路。

examples.en: Local shelters teach children why it is wrong to abuse animals.
examples.zh: 當地收容所教導孩子，為什麼虐待動物是不對的。

examples.en: He was fired for abusing his position.
examples.zh: 他因為濫用職權而被解僱。

senses.zh: 容納；提供住宿；滿足需求

examples.en: The hall can accommodate about five hundred guests.
examples.zh: 這個大廳可以容納大約五百位賓客。

examples.en: The hotel will accommodate our group for three nights.
examples.zh: 這間旅館會讓我們一行人住三晚。

examples.en: The teacher tried to accommodate every student's needs.
examples.zh: 老師盡力照顧每位學生的需求。

examples.en: We booked our accommodation near the train station.
examples.zh: 我們在火車站附近訂了住宿。

examples.en: The price includes accommodation and breakfast.
examples.zh: 這個價格包含住宿和早餐。

examples.en: Finding cheap accommodation in summer is not easy.
examples.zh: 夏天要找到便宜的住宿並不容易。

senses.zh: 協議；一致；意願（用於固定片語）

examples.en: The two countries signed a peace accord last year.
examples.zh: 兩國去年簽署了和平協議。

examples.en: The members spoke with one accord at the meeting.
examples.zh: 會議上成員們異口同聲地發言。

examples.en: The door opened of its own accord.
examples.zh: 門自己打開了。

examples.en: The law accords equal rights to all workers in this country.
examples.zh: 法律賦予這個國家的所有勞工平等權利。

examples.en: His story does not accord with what I heard.
examples.zh: 他的說法和我聽到的不一致。

examples.en: The guests were accorded a warm welcome.
examples.zh: 賓客受到了熱烈的歡迎。

examples.en: Please acquaint yourself with the safety rules.
examples.zh: 請先熟悉安全規則。

examples.en: The guide will acquaint us with the old town.
examples.zh: 導遊會帶我們認識這座老城。

examples.en: I am not well acquainted with this software.
examples.zh: 我對這套軟體不太熟悉。

senses.zh: 行政管理；行政單位；政府

examples.en: The school administration announced a new schedule.
examples.zh: 學校行政單位公布了新的時間表。

examples.en: She works in hospital administration and helps organize appointments for patients.
examples.zh: 她從事醫院行政管理工作，協助安排病人預約。

examples.en: The new administration plans to build more parks.
examples.zh: 新政府計畫興建更多公園。

examples.en: The little girl showed great affection for her puppy.
examples.zh: 小女孩對她的小狗表現出很深的喜愛。

examples.en: Grandma greeted us with a hug full of affection.
examples.zh: 奶奶用充滿深情的擁抱迎接我們。

examples.en: He has a deep affection for his hometown.
examples.zh: 他對家鄉有很深的感情。

examples.en: The store does not sell alcoholic drinks to teenagers.
examples.zh: 這家店不賣含酒精的飲料給青少年。

examples.en: The clinic offers support to alcoholic patients and their families.
examples.zh: 診所為酒精成癮的病人及其家屬提供協助。

examples.en: Alcoholic drinks are not allowed in the park.
examples.zh: 公園內禁止飲用含酒精的飲料。

examples.en: The doctor helped the alcoholic find a support group.
examples.zh: 醫生幫那位酒精成癮者找到了互助團體。

examples.en: My uncle is a recovering alcoholic who attends a weekly support group.
examples.zh: 我叔叔正在從酒精成癮中康復，每週參加一次互助團體。

examples.en: Many alcoholics need help from their families.
examples.zh: 許多酒精成癮者需要家人的協助。

examples.en: The bike path runs alongside the river.
examples.zh: 自行車道沿著河邊延伸。

examples.en: She sat alongside her sister at the concert.
examples.zh: 她在音樂會上坐在姊姊旁邊。

examples.en: He works alongside engineers from many countries.
examples.zh: 他和來自許多國家的工程師一起工作。

examples.en: The ship pulled up and the small boat came alongside.
examples.zh: 大船停了下來，小船靠到它旁邊。

examples.en: A police car drove alongside for a while.
examples.zh: 一輛警車在旁邊並行了一陣子。

examples.en: He ran alongside while his son learned to ride.
examples.zh: 他的兒子學騎車時，他在旁邊跟著跑。

examples.en: The analyst studied the sales data for the company.
examples.zh: 分析師為公司研究銷售數據。

examples.en: A market analyst expects prices to rise next year.
examples.zh: 一位市場分析師預期明年物價會上漲。

examples.en: My cousin works as a data analyst in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我的一位堂表親在台北擔任資料分析師。

examples.en: The singer received loud applause at the end.
examples.zh: 歌手在結束時獲得熱烈的掌聲。

examples.en: There was warm applause for the winning team.
examples.zh: 獲勝的隊伍得到了熱烈的掌聲。

examples.en: The audience gave the dancers a round of applause.
examples.zh: 觀眾為舞者們鼓掌喝采。

examples.en: A refrigerator is a common kitchen appliance.
examples.zh: 冰箱是常見的廚房家電。

examples.en: Turn off every appliance before you leave home.
examples.zh: 出門前請關掉所有電器。

examples.en: This store sells home appliances at low prices.
examples.zh: 這家店以低價販售家電。

examples.en: The architect showed us the plan for the new library.
examples.zh: 建築師向我們展示了新圖書館的設計圖。

examples.en: My aunt is an architect who designs small houses.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是設計小房子的建築師。

examples.en: He is the architect of the company's new strategy.
examples.zh: 他是公司新策略的規劃者。

examples.en: She studies architecture at a university in Tainan.
examples.zh: 她在台南的一所大學讀建築。

examples.en: The old temple is famous for its beautiful architecture.
examples.zh: 這座古老的廟宇以優美的建築聞名。

examples.en: The architecture of this software is easy to understand.
examples.zh: 這套軟體的架構很容易理解。

examples.en: A strange noise from the attic aroused my curiosity.
examples.zh: 閣樓裡傳來的奇怪聲音引起了我的好奇心。

examples.en: The ringing phone aroused me from a deep sleep.
examples.zh: 電話鈴聲把我從熟睡中喚醒。

examples.en: The new rule aroused some doubt among the students.
examples.zh: 這項新規定讓學生們產生了一些疑慮。

examples.en: The company's biggest asset is its team of workers.
examples.zh: 這家公司最大的資產是它的員工團隊。

examples.en: The old building is the family's main asset.
examples.zh: 那棟老房子是這個家庭主要的資產。

examples.en: Your good English is a great asset in this job.
examples.zh: 你良好的英語能力是做這份工作的一大優勢。

examples.en: The magician's disappearing act astonished the children at the party.
examples.zh: 魔術師的消失魔術讓派對上的孩子們大為驚訝。

examples.en: Her fast progress in English astonished her teacher.
examples.zh: 她在英文上的快速進步讓老師大吃一驚。

examples.en: The size of the cake will astonish you.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕的大小會讓你大吃一驚。

examples.en: The school banned phones in the classroom.
examples.zh: 學校禁止在教室使用手機。

examples.en: The city plans to ban plastic bags next year.
examples.zh: 這座城市計畫明年禁用塑膠袋。

examples.en: Smoking is banned in all restaurants under the new city regulations.
examples.zh: 依照市府的新規定，所有餐廳都禁止吸菸。

examples.en: There is a ban on fishing in this lake.
examples.zh: 這座湖禁止釣魚。

examples.en: The government put a ban on loud music after ten.
examples.zh: 政府規定晚上十點後禁止播放大聲的音樂。

examples.en: The ban will end at the start of summer.
examples.zh: 這項禁令將在夏天開始時解除。

examples.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to your health.
examples.zh: 規律運動對你的健康有益。

examples.en: The new bus route is beneficial for local students.
examples.zh: 新的公車路線對當地學生有好處。

examples.en: Reading every night can be beneficial for your English.
examples.zh: 每晚閱讀對你的英文有幫助。

examples.en: Her bid for the old painting was the highest.
examples.zh: 她對那幅舊畫的出價是最高的。

examples.en: The company made a bid to build the new bridge.
examples.zh: 這家公司投標要建造新橋。

examples.en: He made a bid for the position of student council president.
examples.zh: 他努力爭取學生會長的職位。

senses.zh: 出價；投標；向人致意（用於問候或道別）

examples.en: I bid fifty dollars for the used bicycle.
examples.zh: 我為那輛二手腳踏車出價五十元。

examples.en: Three companies will bid for the contract.
examples.zh: 有三家公司將競標這份合約。

examples.en: Before leaving for college, she bid farewell to her hometown friends.
examples.zh: 離家上大學前，她向家鄉的朋友道別。

examples.en: She blushed when the teacher praised her.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚她時，她臉紅了。

examples.en: He began to blush when everyone sang to him.
examples.zh: 大家對他唱歌時，他開始臉紅。

examples.en: Do not blush; your answer was correct.
examples.zh: 別臉紅，你的答案是對的。

examples.en: A blush spread across her cheeks when she received the unexpected compliment.
examples.zh: 她受到意想不到的讚美時，雙頰泛起了紅暈。

examples.en: He tried to hide his blush behind a book.
examples.zh: 他試著用書遮住自己發紅的臉。

examples.en: She applied a little blush to her cheeks before the interview.
examples.zh: 面試前，她在雙頰擦了一點腮紅。

examples.en: He put the report into his leather briefcase.
examples.zh: 他把報告放進皮製公事包裡。

examples.en: My father carries a black briefcase to work.
examples.zh: 我爸爸帶著一個黑色公事包去上班。

examples.en: She left her briefcase on the train.
examples.zh: 她把公事包忘在火車上了。

examples.en: I like to browse the web after dinner.
examples.zh: 我喜歡晚餐後瀏覽網頁。

examples.en: We spent an hour browsing in the bookstore.
examples.zh: 我們在書店裡逛了一個小時。

examples.en: Customers can browse the shelves without any pressure.
examples.zh: 顧客可以毫無壓力地隨意瀏覽貨架上的商品。

senses.zh: 局處等機關；五斗櫃（美式）

examples.en: The tourist bureau gave us a free map.
examples.zh: 旅遊局給了我們一張免費地圖。

examples.en: She works at the weather bureau in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的氣象局工作。

examples.en: She keeps her socks in the top drawer of the bureau.
examples.zh: 她把襪子放在五斗櫃最上面的抽屜裡。

examples.en: The butcher cut the pork into thin slices.
examples.zh: 肉販把豬肉切成薄片。

examples.en: Mom bought fresh beef from the butcher.
examples.zh: 媽媽向肉販買了新鮮的牛肉。

examples.en: The butcher's shop opens at six every morning.
examples.zh: 這間肉舖每天早上六點開門。

examples.en: The boat moved slowly along the canal.
examples.zh: 船沿著運河緩緩前進。

examples.en: They built a canal to bring water to the fields.
examples.zh: 他們挖了一條水道把水引到田裡。

examples.en: Tourists enjoy riding a boat on the canal in Venice.
examples.zh: 遊客喜歡在威尼斯的運河上搭船。

examples.en: The artist painted a river on a large canvas.
examples.zh: 畫家在一大塊畫布上畫了一條河。

examples.en: My canvas shoes got wet in the rain.
examples.zh: 我的帆布鞋被雨淋濕了。

examples.en: We put up a canvas tent by the lake.
examples.zh: 我們在湖邊搭了一頂帆布帳篷。

examples.en: Diamonds and graphite are both made of the element carbon.
examples.zh: 鑽石和石墨都是由碳元素構成的。

examples.en: Cars release carbon into the atmosphere, mainly in the form of carbon dioxide.
examples.zh: 汽車將碳釋放到大氣中，主要以二氧化碳的形式排放。

examples.en: Plants absorb carbon from the air in the form of carbon dioxide.
examples.zh: 植物以二氧化碳的形式從空氣中吸收碳。

examples.en: The graduation ceremony starts at nine tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮明天早上九點開始。

examples.en: The community held a ceremony to honor Grandpa's years of volunteer service.
examples.zh: 社區舉辦了一場典禮，表揚爺爺多年來的志工服務。

examples.en: The tea ceremony was quiet and beautiful.
examples.zh: 茶道儀式安靜又優美。

examples.en: She received a certificate for finishing the English course.
examples.zh: 她完成英文課程後拿到一張結業證書。

examples.en: You need a birth certificate to apply for the passport.
examples.zh: 你申請護照需要出生證明。

examples.en: The store gave me a gift certificate for my birthday.
examples.zh: 這家店在我生日時送我一張禮券。

examples.en: My brother and I share the household chores every weekend.
examples.zh: 我和我的兄弟每個週末分擔家事。

examples.en: Washing the dishes is my least favorite chore.
examples.zh: 洗碗是我最不喜歡的家事。

examples.en: Paying the bills online is no longer a boring chore.
examples.zh: 線上繳費不再是一件無聊的雜務。

examples.en: It was a coincidence that we met at the airport.
examples.zh: 我們在機場遇見純屬巧合。

examples.en: What a coincidence! I was just about to call you.
examples.zh: 真是巧合！我正要打電話給你。

examples.en: The two events happening on the same day was not a coincidence.
examples.zh: 這兩件事在同一天發生不是巧合。

examples.en: The comedian made the whole audience laugh with his story.
examples.zh: 這位喜劇演員用他的故事逗得全場觀眾大笑。

examples.en: My uncle wants to become a comedian someday.
examples.zh: 我叔叔想有一天成為喜劇演員。

examples.en: She is a famous comedian who often appears on television.
examples.zh: 她是常上電視的知名喜劇演員。

examples.en: The salesperson earns a commission on every car he sells.
examples.zh: 這位業務員每賣出一輛車就能賺取佣金。

examples.en: The city set up a commission to study the traffic problem.
examples.zh: 市政府成立了一個委員會來研究交通問題。

examples.en: The artist received a commission to paint the school mural.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家受託繪製學校的壁畫。

examples.en: The school commissioned a local artist to paint a mural.
examples.zh: 學校委託一位當地藝術家繪製壁畫。

examples.en: The company commissioned a report on customer needs.
examples.zh: 公司委託製作一份顧客需求報告。

examples.en: They commissioned a new bridge to connect the two towns.
examples.zh: 他們委託興建一座新橋來連接兩個城鎮。

senses.zh: 承諾；投入；已答應的事情

examples.en: He made a commitment to exercise three times a week.
examples.zh: 他承諾每週運動三次。

examples.en: Learning a language takes time and commitment.
examples.zh: 學語言需要時間和投入。

examples.en: I have a prior commitment on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 我星期五晚上已經有約了。

examples.en: The history book explains what a communist believed in the last century.
examples.zh: 這本歷史書說明上個世紀共產主義者相信什麼。

examples.en: The museum displayed letters written by a communist during the last century.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一位共產主義者在上個世紀寫的信。

examples.en: The teacher explained why the writer described himself as a communist.
examples.zh: 老師解釋了那位作家為何自稱共產主義者。

examples.en: The class studied the communist system of the twentieth century.
examples.zh: 這個班級研究了二十世紀的共產主義體制。

examples.en: The book describes a communist country in Eastern Europe.
examples.zh: 這本書描述東歐的一個共產主義國家。

examples.en: He wrote a report on communist ideas in history class.
examples.zh: 他在歷史課寫了一篇關於共產主義思想的報告。

examples.en: She gave me a compliment on my new haircut.
examples.zh: 她稱讚我的新髮型。

examples.en: Thank you for the compliment, but I still have much to learn.
examples.zh: 謝謝你的讚美，不過我還有很多要學。

examples.en: The chef was pleased by the customer's kind compliment.
examples.zh: 主廚對顧客的親切讚美感到很開心。

examples.en: The teacher complimented him on his clear presentation.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚他的簡報清楚明瞭。

examples.en: Everyone complimented the host on the delicious dinner.
examples.zh: 大家都稱讚主人準備了美味的晚餐。

examples.en: My aunt complimented my sister on her piano playing.
examples.zh: 我姑姑稱讚我妹妹的鋼琴彈得好。

senses.zh: 化合物；複合字；圍起的場地（內有建築物）

examples.en: Water is a compound made of hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 水是由氫和氧組成的化合物。

examples.en: The factory sits inside a large compound near the river.
examples.zh: 這間工廠位在河邊的一大片院區內。

examples.en: The teacher explained how compounds are formed by combining two or more words.
examples.zh: 老師說明如何把兩個或更多的字結合成複合字。

examples.en: A compound sentence has two or more main clauses.
examples.zh: 並列複句含有兩個或更多的主要子句。

examples.en: The bank pays compound interest on this savings account.
examples.zh: 銀行對這個儲蓄帳戶支付複利。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to identify compound words in the passage.
examples.zh: 老師要我們找出文章中的複合字。

examples.en: Heavy rain compounded the traffic problems downtown.
examples.zh: 大雨使市中心的交通問題更加嚴重。

examples.en: Lack of sleep will compound your stress before the exam.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足會讓你考前的壓力更大。

examples.en: The delay was compounded by a mistake in the schedule.
examples.zh: 時程表上的錯誤使延誤更加惡化。

examples.en: The teacher checked our comprehension of the story with a few questions.
examples.zh: 老師用幾個問題檢查我們對故事的理解。

examples.en: Reading comprehension is an important part of the English test.
examples.zh: 閱讀理解是英文考試的重要部分。

examples.en: The speech was beyond the comprehension of the young children.
examples.zh: 這場演講超出了小朋友的理解範圍。

examples.en: She tried to conceal her disappointment behind a smile.
examples.zh: 她試著用笑容掩飾自己的失望。

examples.en: The thick fog concealed the mountain from view.
examples.zh: 濃霧把山遮住了，看不見。

examples.en: He did not conceal the truth from his parents.
examples.zh: 他沒有對父母隱瞞實情。

examples.en: The students will conduct an experiment in the science lab.
examples.zh: 學生們將在科學實驗室進行實驗。

examples.en: Mr. Lin will conduct the school orchestra at the concert.
examples.zh: 林老師將在音樂會上指揮學校的管弦樂團。

examples.en: Copper conducts heat better than most other metals.
examples.zh: 銅比大多數其他金屬更能傳熱。

examples.en: The teacher praised the class for their good conduct on the trip.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚全班在旅途中的良好表現。

examples.en: The company has a strict code of conduct for all employees.
examples.zh: 公司對所有員工都有嚴格的行為準則。

examples.en: His conduct at the meeting surprised everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他在會議上的舉止讓在場所有人都很驚訝。

examples.en: The doctor told him to confine himself to bed for two days.
examples.zh: 醫生要他在床上靜養兩天。

examples.en: Please confine your answer to one page.
examples.zh: 請把你的答案限制在一頁以內。

examples.en: Heavy snow confined us to the hotel all afternoon.
examples.zh: 大雪讓我們整個下午都困在旅館裡。

examples.en: You must confront your fears before you can overcome them.
examples.zh: 你必須先正視恐懼，才能克服它們。

examples.en: The manager confronted the team about the missed deadline.
examples.zh: 經理就錯過截止日期的事質問整個團隊。

examples.en: The town is confronted with a serious water shortage.
examples.zh: 這個城鎮正面臨嚴重的缺水問題。

examples.en: The two neighbors had a confrontation over the loud music.
examples.zh: 兩位鄰居為了吵鬧的音樂起了衝突。

examples.en: She wanted to avoid a confrontation with her boss.
examples.zh: 她想避免和老闆正面衝突。

examples.en: The meeting ended without any confrontation between the groups.
examples.zh: 會議結束時，兩個團體之間沒有發生任何衝突。

examples.en: The museum has a large collection of contemporary art.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有大量的當代藝術收藏。

examples.en: She enjoys reading contemporary writers from Taiwan.
examples.zh: 她喜歡閱讀台灣的當代作家。

examples.en: The historian used contemporary diaries to study life in the eighteenth century.
examples.zh: 這位歷史學家利用十八世紀當時的日記研究那個年代的生活。

examples.en: Shakespeare was a contemporary of Queen Elizabeth.
examples.zh: 莎士比亞與伊莉莎白女王是同時代的人。

examples.en: He was admired by his contemporaries for his honesty.
examples.zh: 他的誠實受到同時代人的敬佩。

examples.en: My grandfather and his contemporaries grew up without television.
examples.zh: 我祖父和他那個年代的人成長時沒有電視。

examples.en: The continental climate there has hot summers and cold winters.
examples.zh: 那裡的大陸性氣候夏天炎熱、冬天寒冷。

examples.en: The hotel serves a continental breakfast with bread and coffee.
examples.zh: 這家旅館供應有麵包和咖啡的歐陸式早餐。

examples.en: Asia has the largest continental area in the world.
examples.zh: 亞洲擁有世界上最大的大陸面積。

examples.en: The corporation plans to open a new office in Taipei.
examples.zh: 這家公司計畫在台北開設新辦公室。

examples.en: She works for a large corporation that makes computer parts.
examples.zh: 她任職於一家製造電腦零件的大企業。

examples.en: The mayor invited several corporations to join the project.
examples.zh: 市長邀請了幾家企業參與這項專案。

examples.en: The foreign correspondent reported live from Paris last night.
examples.zh: 這位駐外特派員昨晚從巴黎現場報導。

examples.en: My pen pal is a regular correspondent from Canada.
examples.zh: 我的筆友是一位固定從加拿大來信的通信者。

examples.en: She works as a news correspondent for a local newspaper.
examples.zh: 她擔任當地報社的新聞特派員。

examples.en: Please walk quietly in the corridor during class.
examples.zh: 上課時請在走廊安靜行走。

examples.en: The classroom is at the end of the long corridor.
examples.zh: 教室在長走廊的盡頭。

examples.en: The nurse hurried down the corridor to the emergency room.
examples.zh: 護理師快步走過走廊前往急診室。

examples.en: The hotel staff were friendly and courteous to every guest.
examples.zh: 旅館員工對每位客人都親切又有禮。

examples.en: It is courteous to say thank you after a meal.
examples.zh: 用餐後說聲謝謝是有禮貌的。

examples.en: He sent a courteous reply to the customer's email.
examples.zh: 他寄了一封有禮貌的回信給顧客。

examples.en: A strike crippled the airport for two days.
examples.zh: 一場罷工讓機場癱瘓了兩天。

examples.en: The storm crippled the power system across the whole city.
examples.zh: 暴風雨讓全市的供電系統嚴重受損。

examples.en: Heavy debt can cripple a small business.
examples.zh: 沉重的債務可能會拖垮一家小企業。

examples.en: She wore a necklace made of clear crystal.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條透明水晶做的項鍊。

examples.en: Salt forms small crystals when the water dries.
examples.zh: 水乾掉後，鹽會形成小結晶。

examples.en: The vase is made of crystal that shines under the lights.
examples.zh: 這個花瓶用水晶玻璃製成，在燈光下閃耀。

senses.zh: 水晶製的；水晶玻璃製的

examples.en: A crystal pendant hung from the thin chain around her neck.
examples.zh: 一枚水晶墜飾掛在她頸間的細鍊上。

examples.en: The chandelier has crystal pieces that sparkle when the lights are on.
examples.zh: 這盞吊燈上有水晶玻璃飾片，開燈時會閃閃發亮。

examples.en: She served the juice in crystal glasses at the dinner party.
examples.zh: 她在晚宴上用水晶玻璃杯盛裝果汁。

examples.en: We waited in line at customs after the long flight.
examples.zh: 長途飛行後，我們在海關排隊等候。

examples.en: Every country has its own customs and traditions.
examples.zh: 每個國家都有自己的風俗和傳統。

examples.en: Importers must pay customs on certain goods brought into the country.
examples.zh: 進口商必須為某些輸入國內的貨物繳納關稅。

examples.en: Eating too much candy can cause tooth decay.
examples.zh: 吃太多糖果可能造成蛀牙。

examples.en: The old house fell into decay after many years.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子在多年後逐漸破敗。

examples.en: Scientists studied the decay of leaves on the forest floor.
examples.zh: 科學家研究森林地面上落葉的腐爛情形。

examples.en: Fruit will decay quickly if you leave it in the sun.
examples.zh: 水果放在太陽下會很快腐爛。

examples.en: Dead leaves slowly decay and become part of the soil.
examples.zh: 枯葉慢慢腐爛，變成土壤的一部分。

examples.en: The old bridge began to decay after years of rain.
examples.zh: 這座老橋在多年雨水侵蝕後開始毀壞。

examples.en: You should not deceive your friends to get what you want.
examples.zh: 你不應該為了達成目的而欺騙朋友。

examples.en: The fake website was designed to deceive shoppers.
examples.zh: 這個假網站的設計目的是矇騙購物者。

examples.en: Her cheerful smile deceived us into thinking she was happy.
examples.zh: 她開朗的笑容讓我們誤以為她很開心。

examples.en: The mayor made a declaration about the new park rules.
examples.zh: 市長就新的公園規則發表聲明。

examples.en: Please fill out the customs declaration form before landing.
examples.zh: 請在降落前填寫海關申報單。

examples.en: The Declaration of Independence is an important document in American history.
examples.zh: 《獨立宣言》是美國歷史上的重要文件。

examples.en: She politely declined the invitation to the party.
examples.zh: 她客氣地婉拒了派對的邀請。

examples.en: The number of visitors declined sharply last winter.
examples.zh: 去年冬天遊客人數大幅下降。

examples.en: His health began to decline after he turned eighty.
examples.zh: 他八十歲之後健康開始衰退。

examples.en: There has been a decline in sales this month.
examples.zh: 這個月的銷售額下滑了。

examples.en: The report shows a steady decline in the birth rate.
examples.zh: 報告顯示出生率持續下降。

examples.en: The decline of the old town began when the factory closed.
examples.zh: 老城鎮的沒落始於工廠關閉之後。

examples.en: The city has a budget deficit this year.
examples.zh: 這座城市今年有預算赤字。

examples.en: The company reported a deficit of two million dollars.
examples.zh: 這家公司回報了兩百萬元的虧損。

examples.en: A water deficit can hurt the farmers in this area.
examples.zh: 缺水會傷害這個地區的農民。

examples.en: Each school sent a delegate to the youth meeting.
examples.zh: 每所學校都派了一位代表參加青年會議。

examples.en: She was chosen as the class delegate for the student council.
examples.zh: 她被選為班級代表參加學生會。

examples.en: The delegates from many countries arrived on Monday.
examples.zh: 來自許多國家的代表星期一抵達了。

examples.en: A good manager knows how to delegate work to the team.
examples.zh: 好主管懂得把工作交給團隊。

examples.en: The principal delegated the task to the vice principal.
examples.zh: 校長把這項任務交給副校長負責。

examples.en: He was delegated to speak for the whole class.
examples.zh: 他被推派為全班發言。

examples.en: The teacher described him as a true democrat who respected everyone's vote.
examples.zh: 老師形容他是一位真正的民主主義者，尊重每個人的投票。

examples.en: She is a democrat who believes citizens should have a voice.
examples.zh: 她是相信人民應該有發言權的民主主義者。

examples.en: The book tells the story of a young democrat in the last century.
examples.zh: 這本書講述上個世紀一位年輕民主人士的故事。

examples.en: Rainy weather can depress people who miss the sun.
examples.zh: 陰雨天氣會讓想念陽光的人心情低落。

examples.en: The bad news did not depress her for long.
examples.zh: 這個壞消息並沒有讓她沮喪太久。

examples.en: Poor sales may depress the price of the product.
examples.zh: 銷售不佳可能會使產品價格下跌。

examples.en: The manager's deputy will lead the meeting while she is away.
examples.zh: 經理不在時，將由她的副手主持會議。

examples.en: Mr. Chen asked his deputy to handle the visitors.
examples.zh: 陳先生請他的副手負責接待訪客。

examples.en: The mayor sent a deputy to open the new library last week.
examples.zh: 市長上週派了一名代理人，為新圖書館揭幕。

examples.en: She cried in despair when she lost her phone.
examples.zh: 她弄丟手機時絕望地哭了。

examples.en: The farmers were in despair after the long drought.
examples.zh: 長期乾旱之後，農民們陷入絕望。

examples.en: He looked at the broken toy with despair.
examples.zh: 他絕望地看著壞掉的玩具。

examples.en: Don't despair if you fail the first test.
examples.zh: 如果第一次考試沒過，不要灰心。

examples.en: They despaired of finding the lost dog before dark.
examples.zh: 他們對天黑前找到走失的狗已不抱希望。

examples.en: She began to despair about ever finishing the project.
examples.zh: 她開始對能否完成專案感到絕望。

examples.en: Tokyo is our final destination on this trip.
examples.zh: 東京是我們這趟旅行的最終目的地。

examples.en: The bus arrived at its destination ten minutes late.
examples.zh: 公車晚了十分鐘抵達目的地。

examples.en: Taiwan is a popular travel destination for many tourists.
examples.zh: 台灣是許多遊客喜愛的旅遊目的地。

examples.en: The typhoon was very destructive to the coastal towns.
examples.zh: 這場颱風對沿海城鎮造成嚴重破壞。

examples.en: Too much stress can be destructive to your health.
examples.zh: 壓力太大可能對健康有害。

examples.en: The children learned that being destructive with toys is not acceptable.
examples.zh: 孩子們學到破壞玩具是不被接受的。

examples.en: The nurse is known for her devotion to her patients.
examples.zh: 這位護理師以對病人的奉獻聞名。

examples.en: His devotion to music began when he was five.
examples.zh: 他從五歲起就熱愛音樂。

examples.en: The dog's devotion to its owner never faded as it grew older.
examples.zh: 這隻狗年紀漸長，對主人的忠誠卻絲毫未減。

examples.en: My grandmother speaks a local dialect at home.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在家說當地的方言。

examples.en: Each region of the island has its own dialect.
examples.zh: 這座島的每個地區都有自己的方言。

examples.en: The singer wrote a song in the northern dialect.
examples.zh: 這位歌手用北方方言寫了一首歌。

examples.en: Walking after dinner can help your digestion.
examples.zh: 晚餐後散步有助於消化。

examples.en: Fiber is good for digestion and heart health.
examples.zh: 纖維對消化和心臟健康有益。

examples.en: The doctor explained how the stomach and intestines work together during digestion.
examples.zh: 醫師解釋胃和腸道在消化過程中如何共同運作。

examples.en: My parents disapprove of staying up late on school nights.
examples.zh: 我父母不贊成在隔天要上學的晚上熬夜。

examples.en: The teacher disapproved of using phones during the test.
examples.zh: 老師不贊成考試時使用手機。

examples.en: She disapproves of the way he talks to waiters.
examples.zh: 她不贊同他對服務生說話的方式。

examples.en: Please disconnect the charger before you leave the room.
examples.zh: 離開房間前請拔掉充電器。

examples.en: The call was disconnected in the middle of our talk.
examples.zh: 我們談到一半，通話就斷線了。

examples.en: He disconnected the printer from the computer.
examples.zh: 他中斷了印表機與電腦的連接。

examples.en: Sugar dissolves quickly in hot tea when you stir it gently.
examples.zh: 輕輕攪拌時，糖在熱茶中很快就會溶解。

examples.en: The club was dissolved after the leader moved away.
examples.zh: 社團負責人搬走後，社團就解散了。

examples.en: Her worries began to dissolve when she heard the good news.
examples.zh: 她聽到好消息後，煩惱開始消失。

examples.en: There is a clear distinction between a fruit and a vegetable.
examples.zh: 水果與蔬菜之間有明顯的區別。

examples.en: She graduated with distinction from the music school.
examples.zh: 她以優異成績從音樂學校畢業。

examples.en: Students should learn to make a distinction between facts and opinions.
examples.zh: 學生應該學會區分事實與意見。

examples.en: Our class decided to donate old books to the library.
examples.zh: 我們班決定把舊書捐給圖書館。

examples.en: Many people donate money after a natural disaster.
examples.zh: 許多人在天災後捐款。

examples.en: He donates blood at the hospital every few months.
examples.zh: 他每隔幾個月就到醫院捐血。

examples.en: We had a dreadful storm during our trip to Hualien.
examples.zh: 我們到花蓮旅行時遇到了一場可怕的暴風雨。

examples.en: The soup tasted dreadful, so I couldn't finish it.
examples.zh: 這碗湯味道很糟，所以我沒辦法喝完。

examples.en: It was a dreadful mistake to leave the door open.
examples.zh: 把門開著是個糟糕的錯誤。

examples.en: The long drought left the reservoir almost empty.
examples.zh: 長期乾旱讓水庫幾乎見底。

examples.en: Farmers worry about drought during the summer months.
examples.zh: 農民在夏季擔心旱災。

examples.en: The government asked people to save water during the drought.
examples.zh: 乾旱期間，政府呼籲民眾節約用水。

senses.zh: 精心製作的；複雜的；詳盡的

examples.en: They prepared an elaborate dinner for the guests.
examples.zh: 他們為客人準備了一頓精心製作的晚餐。

examples.en: The students made an elaborate model of the solar system.
examples.zh: 學生們做了一個精細的太陽系模型。

examples.en: She presented an elaborate plan for the school trip to the parents.
examples.zh: 她向家長提出一份詳盡的校外教學計畫。

examples.en: Could you elaborate on your idea a little more?
examples.zh: 你可以再詳細說明一下你的想法嗎？

examples.en: The manager elaborated on the new rules at the meeting.
examples.zh: 經理在會議上詳細說明了新規定。

examples.en: He refused to elaborate on why he left the company.
examples.zh: 他拒絕詳細說明自己為何離開公司。

examples.en: He started a small enterprise selling handmade bags online.
examples.zh: 他創辦了一家在網路上販售手工包包的小企業。

examples.en: The new enterprise created over fifty jobs in the town.
examples.zh: 這項新事業為小鎮創造了五十多個工作機會。

examples.en: Her enterprise and hard work helped the shop succeed.
examples.zh: 她的進取心與努力幫助這家店成功。

examples.en: The students were enthusiastic about the school trip.
examples.zh: 學生們對校外教學興致勃勃。

examples.en: She gave an enthusiastic speech at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 她在開幕典禮上發表了熱情洋溢的演說。

examples.en: Our new teacher is enthusiastic about teaching science.
examples.zh: 我們的新老師熱衷於教自然科學。

examples.en: This card entitles you to a free drink every Friday.
examples.zh: 這張卡讓你每週五都能免費領一杯飲料。

examples.en: Every member is entitled to vote at the meeting.
examples.zh: 每位成員都有權在會議上投票。

examples.en: The author entitled her first book Summer Rain.
examples.zh: 作者把她的第一本書命名為《夏雨》。

examples.en: I was envious of her when she won a free trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 她贏得免費的日本之旅時，我好羨慕她。

examples.en: He felt envious of his classmate's new bicycle.
examples.zh: 他很羨慕同學的新腳踏車。

examples.en: Don't be envious of others; focus on your own goals.
examples.zh: 不要嫉妒別人，專心完成自己的目標。

examples.en: One kilometer is equivalent to about 0.6 miles.
examples.zh: 一公里大約等於 0.6 英里。

examples.en: The two jobs offer equivalent salaries but require very different skills.
examples.zh: 這兩份工作的薪水相當，但所需技能卻很不同。

examples.en: A hundred points is equivalent to one free coffee here.
examples.zh: 在這裡，一百點相當於一杯免費咖啡。

examples.en: This word has no exact equivalent in English.
examples.zh: 這個字在英文裡沒有完全對應的說法。

examples.en: Her degree is the equivalent of a bachelor's degree abroad.
examples.zh: 她的學位相當於國外的學士學位。

examples.en: Is there an equivalent of this medicine that costs less?
examples.zh: 這種藥有沒有價格比較低的替代品？

examples.en: The soldier stood erect while the flag was raised.
examples.zh: 升旗時，士兵挺直地站著。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to keep our backs erect.
examples.zh: 老師要求我們把背挺直。

examples.en: The old tree still stands erect after the storm.
examples.zh: 這棵老樹在暴風雨後仍然筆直地挺立著。

examples.en: The city plans to erect a new statue in the park.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫在公園裡豎立一座新雕像。

examples.en: They will erect a tent for the school fair.
examples.zh: 他們會為園遊會搭一頂帳篷。

examples.en: Workers erected a fence around the building site.
examples.zh: 工人在工地周圍架起圍籬。

examples.en: I have to run an errand for my mother after school.
examples.zh: 放學後我得幫媽媽跑腿。

examples.en: She spent the morning doing errands in town.
examples.zh: 她一早都在鎮上辦雜事。

examples.en: He sent his son on an errand to the bakery.
examples.zh: 他派兒子到麵包店跑一趟。

examples.en: Please stand on the right side of the escalator.
examples.zh: 請站在手扶梯的右側。

examples.en: The escalator in the mall stopped working this morning.
examples.zh: 購物中心的手扶梯今天早上停止運轉了。

examples.en: We took the escalator up to the third floor.
examples.zh: 我們搭手扶梯到三樓。

senses.zh: 莊園；遺產；房地產（用於固定片語）

examples.en: The family lives on a large estate near the lake.
examples.zh: 這家人住在湖邊的一座大莊園。

examples.en: My uncle works for a real estate company.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在一家房地產公司上班。

examples.en: She inherited her grandfather's estate last year.
examples.zh: 她去年繼承了祖父的遺產。

examples.en: Darwin's theory of evolution changed how we see nature.
examples.zh: 達爾文的演化論改變了我們看待自然的方式。

examples.en: The evolution of the smartphone has been very fast.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機的發展非常快速。

examples.en: The museum has an exhibit about human evolution.
examples.zh: 博物館有一個關於人類演化的展覽。

examples.en: Birds evolved from small dinosaurs millions of years ago.
examples.zh: 鳥類在數百萬年前從小型恐龍演化而來。

examples.en: Our company has evolved a lot in the past decade.
examples.zh: 我們公司在過去十年有很大的演變。

examples.en: Languages evolve as people use them in new ways.
examples.zh: 語言會隨著人們用新的方式使用而演變。

examples.en: She is an exceptional student with a great memory.
examples.zh: 她是一位記憶力很好的傑出學生。

examples.en: The hotel offers exceptional service to every guest.
examples.zh: 這家旅館為每位客人提供極為優質的服務。

examples.en: Snow in this city is exceptional, even in winter.
examples.zh: 這座城市就算在冬天也很少下雪。

examples.en: "What a beautiful view!" she exclaimed from the top of the mountain.
examples.zh: 「好美的景色啊！」她在山頂驚呼道。

examples.en: The children exclaimed with joy when they saw the gifts.
examples.zh: 孩子們看到禮物時高興地叫了起來。

examples.en: He exclaimed that the price was far too high.
examples.zh: 他大聲說價格實在太高了。

examples.en: The executive spoke to the staff about the new plan.
examples.zh: 那位主管向員工說明新計畫。

examples.en: My aunt is a senior executive at a bank.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是一家銀行的高階主管。

examples.en: Several executives will attend the meeting tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天有幾位主管會出席會議。

examples.en: The executive board approved the budget on Monday.
examples.zh: 執行董事會星期一通過了預算。

examples.en: She holds an executive position in the company.
examples.zh: 她在公司擔任高階管理職位。

examples.en: The executive branch of the government carries out the laws.
examples.zh: 政府的行政部門負責執行法律。

examples.en: Some companies exploit workers by paying them too little.
examples.zh: 有些公司付給員工的薪水太少，藉此剝削他們。

examples.en: We should exploit this chance to learn something new.
examples.zh: 我們應該利用這個機會學點新東西。

examples.en: The country plans to exploit its natural resources carefully.
examples.zh: 這個國家打算謹慎地開發自然資源。

examples.en: The old sailor told us about his exploits at sea.
examples.zh: 那位老水手向我們講述他在海上的壯舉。

examples.en: Her exploits made her a hero in her hometown.
examples.zh: 她的功績讓她成為家鄉的英雄。

examples.en: The book describes the exploits of a young explorer.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了一位年輕探險家的事蹟。

examples.en: I asked the teacher for an extension on my essay.
examples.zh: 我向老師申請延後繳交我的報告。

examples.en: The school is building an extension to the library.
examples.zh: 學校正在擴建圖書館。

examples.en: Please call extension 205 to reach the sales office.
examples.zh: 要找業務部請撥分機 205。

examples.en: The library has an extensive collection of old maps.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館收藏了大量的古地圖。

examples.en: She has extensive experience in teaching English.
examples.zh: 她有豐富的英語教學經驗。

examples.en: The storm caused extensive damage to the town.
examples.zh: 暴風雨對小鎮造成了大範圍的損害。

examples.en: Dinosaurs other than birds became extinct about sixty-six million years ago.
examples.zh: 鳥類以外的恐龍約在六千六百萬年前滅絕。

examples.en: Many animals will go extinct if their forests disappear.
examples.zh: 如果森林消失，許多動物將會絕種。

examples.en: The museum shows a model of an extinct bird.
examples.zh: 博物館展示一隻已絕種鳥類的模型。

examples.en: The young pianist has extraordinary talent and performs confidently on stage.
examples.zh: 這位年輕鋼琴家才華非凡，在舞台上演出時充滿自信。

examples.en: It was an extraordinary day for the whole school.
examples.zh: 對全校來說，那是特別的一天。

examples.en: She showed extraordinary courage during the rescue.
examples.zh: 她在救援過程中展現了驚人的勇氣。

examples.en: Space travel has always fascinated my little brother.
examples.zh: 太空旅行一直讓我弟弟著迷。

examples.en: The magic show fascinated the children with its surprising tricks.
examples.zh: 魔術表演中出人意料的戲法讓孩子們看得入迷。

examples.en: Old coins fascinate him, so he collects them.
examples.zh: 老硬幣深深吸引他，所以他收集它們。

examples.en: The federal government collects taxes across the country.
examples.zh: 聯邦政府向全國徵稅。

examples.en: Switzerland is a federal republic made up of twenty-six cantons.
examples.zh: 瑞士是由二十六個邦組成的聯邦共和國。

examples.en: The agency enforces federal laws that protect workers across the country.
examples.zh: 這個機關執行保護全國勞工的聯邦法律。

examples.en: The school will grant her a scholarship next year.
examples.zh: 學校明年會給她獎學金。

examples.en: The manager granted my request for a day off.
examples.zh: 經理批准了我請一天假的要求。

examples.en: I grant that your plan is better than mine.
examples.zh: 我承認你的計畫比我的好。

examples.en: She received a research grant from the university.
examples.zh: 她從大學獲得一筆研究補助金。

examples.en: The town used a grant to repair the old library.
examples.zh: 小鎮用一筆補助金修繕老圖書館。

examples.en: Students can apply for a grant to study abroad.
examples.zh: 學生可以申請出國讀書的補助。

examples.en: Gravity pulls objects toward the center of the Earth.
examples.zh: 重力會把物體拉向地球中心。

examples.en: There is much less gravity on the moon.
examples.zh: 月球上的重力小得多。

examples.en: The doctor explained the gravity of his illness.
examples.zh: 醫生說明了他病情的嚴重性。

examples.en: The whole family grieved when their grandfather passed away.
examples.zh: 祖父過世時，全家人都很悲痛。

examples.en: It takes time to grieve for a lost friend.
examples.zh: 哀悼失去的朋友需要時間。
