examples.en: She grieved over the loss of her old dog.
examples.zh: 她為失去老狗而傷心不已。

senses.zh: 因此；從現在算起（與時間詞連用）

examples.en: The road is closed, hence the traffic jam.
examples.zh: 道路封閉了，因此才會塞車。

examples.en: He lost his keys, and hence he could not open the door.
examples.zh: 他弄丟了鑰匙，所以打不開門。

examples.en: The new library is expected to open two years hence.
examples.zh: 新圖書館預計兩年後開放。

senses.zh: 光榮的；值得尊敬的；正直的

examples.en: He is an honorable man who always keeps his promises.
examples.zh: 他是個正直的人，總是遵守承諾。

examples.en: Serving the country is an honorable job.
examples.zh: 為國家服務是光榮的工作。

examples.en: She earned an honorable mention in the speech contest.
examples.zh: 她在演講比賽中獲得佳作。

examples.en: The police worked hard to free the hostage safely.
examples.zh: 警方努力讓人質安全獲釋。

examples.en: The movie is about a hostage who escapes from a ship.
examples.zh: 這部電影講的是一名從船上逃脫的人質。

examples.en: All the hostages returned home to their families.
examples.zh: 所有的人質都回到家人身邊。

examples.en: Housing in big cities is often very expensive.
examples.zh: 大城市的住宅價格往往很昂貴。

examples.en: The government built new housing for young families.
examples.zh: 政府為年輕家庭興建新住宅。

examples.en: Students can apply for housing near the campus.
examples.zh: 學生可以申請學校附近的住宿。

examples.en: The school will implement a new reading program in March.
examples.zh: 學校三月會實施新的閱讀計畫。

examples.en: It is hard to implement the plan without enough money.
examples.zh: 沒有足夠的錢就很難執行這項計畫。

examples.en: The company implemented the changes last month.
examples.zh: 公司上個月已實施這些變更。

examples.en: A spade is a useful farm implement.
examples.zh: 鏟子是一種好用的農具。

examples.en: The museum displays stone implements from ancient times.
examples.zh: 博物館展示古代的石製工具。

examples.en: Each cook needs a sharp implement for cutting.
examples.zh: 每位廚師都需要一件鋒利的切割工具。

senses.zh: 隱含的意思；可能的影響

examples.en: What is the implication of his strange comment?
examples.zh: 他那句奇怪的評論有什麼含意？

examples.en: The new law has serious implications for small shops.
examples.zh: 這項新法律可能對小商店帶來重大影響。

examples.en: I don't like the implication that I am lazy.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡那種說我懶惰的暗示。

examples.en: Change is inevitable, so we must learn to adapt.
examples.zh: 改變是無可避免的，所以我們必須學會適應。

examples.en: With so much snow, a delay was inevitable.
examples.zh: 雪這麼大，延誤是難免的。

examples.en: It was inevitable that prices would rise this year.
examples.zh: 今年物價上漲是必然的。

examples.en: The virus can infect people through close contact.
examples.zh: 這種病毒可能透過近距離接觸感染人。

examples.en: Wash your hands so you don't infect others.
examples.zh: 把手洗乾淨，才不會傳染給別人。

examples.en: The cut became infected because it was not cleaned.
examples.zh: 傷口沒有清理，所以感染了。

senses.zh: 繼承；遺傳到；接手（既有的問題或狀況）

examples.en: She will inherit the house from her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她會從祖母那裡繼承這棟房子。

examples.en: I inherited my mother's curly hair.
examples.zh: 我遺傳了媽媽的捲髮。

examples.en: The new manager inherited several problems from the last one.
examples.zh: 新經理從前任手中接下了好幾個問題。

examples.en: The nurse will inject the medicine into your arm.
examples.zh: 護理師會把藥物注射到你的手臂。

examples.en: Doctors inject children with vaccines to protect them.
examples.zh: 醫師為孩子注射疫苗來保護他們。

examples.en: The new owner injected money into the small business.
examples.zh: 新老闆投入資金來扶植這家小公司。

examples.en: The child cried a little after the injection.
examples.zh: 孩子打完針後哭了一下。

examples.en: She got a flu injection at the clinic.
examples.zh: 她在診所打了流感疫苗。

examples.en: The company needed an injection of cash to survive.
examples.zh: 這家公司需要注入一筆資金才能撐下去。

examples.en: I made an inquiry about the price of the tickets.
examples.zh: 我詢問了票價。

examples.en: The school started an inquiry into the missing books.
examples.zh: 學校針對遺失的書展開調查。

examples.en: Please send your inquiry by email to our office.
examples.zh: 請用電子郵件把你的詢問寄到我們辦公室。

examples.en: She studies at a technology institute in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她就讀台北一所科技學院。

examples.en: The institute publishes a report on climate each year.
examples.zh: 這個研究機構每年發表一份氣候報告。

examples.en: My brother works at a research institute.
examples.zh: 我的兄弟在一間研究機構工作。

examples.en: The school will institute new rules next semester.
examples.zh: 學校下學期將開始實施新規定。

examples.en: The city instituted a plan to reduce traffic.
examples.zh: 市政府開始實施一項減少車流的計畫。

examples.en: They want to institute a weekly meeting for the team.
examples.zh: 他們想訂出團隊每週開會的制度。

examples.en: The bank is a well-known financial institution.
examples.zh: 這家銀行是知名的金融機構。

examples.en: Marriage is an old institution in many cultures.
examples.zh: 婚姻在許多文化中是古老的制度。

examples.en: The university is the oldest institution in the city.
examples.zh: 這所大學是城裡最古老的機構。

examples.en: The coach will intensify our training before the game.
examples.zh: 教練會在比賽前加強我們的訓練。

examples.en: The wind began to intensify late in the evening.
examples.zh: 接近深夜時，風勢開始增強。

examples.en: The company intensified its efforts to attract new customers.
examples.zh: 公司加強努力以吸引新客戶。

examples.en: I don't like his interference in my private life.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡他干涉我的私生活。

examples.en: There was a lot of interference on the radio.
examples.zh: 收音機有很多雜訊干擾。

examples.en: The project was finished without any interference from the boss.
examples.zh: 這項專案在完全沒有老闆干預的情況下完成了。

examples.en: Everyone has a different interpretation of this poem.
examples.zh: 每個人對這首詩都有不同的詮釋。

examples.en: Her interpretation of the data surprised the teacher.
examples.zh: 她對數據的解讀讓老師很驚訝。

examples.en: The conference offered simultaneous interpretation so visitors could follow every speech.
examples.zh: 這場會議提供同步口譯，讓訪客能聽懂每場演講。

examples.en: There was a short interval between the two acts.
examples.zh: 兩幕之間有一小段休息時間。

examples.en: The nurse told him to take the medicine at four-hour intervals.
examples.zh: 護理師告訴他要每隔四小時服藥一次。

examples.en: The buses run at ten-minute intervals during the morning rush hour.
examples.zh: 早上尖峰時段，公車每隔十分鐘就有一班。

examples.en: The jury listened carefully to both sides of the case.
examples.zh: 陪審團仔細聆聽了雙方的說法。

examples.en: The jury will announce the winner of the contest tonight.
examples.zh: 評審團今晚會公布比賽的優勝者。

examples.en: She was chosen to serve on a jury last month.
examples.zh: 她上個月被選為陪審員。

examples.en: The movie is about a man who tries to kidnap a famous singer.
examples.zh: 這部電影講的是一個企圖綁架知名歌手的男子。

examples.en: Police say the criminals planned to kidnap the boy.
examples.zh: 警方說歹徒原本打算綁架那個男孩。

examples.en: The story tells how the hero saved a kidnapped child.
examples.zh: 這個故事描述英雄如何救出被綁架的孩子。

examples.en: Our landlord is going to repair the roof next week.
examples.zh: 我們的房東下週會修理屋頂。

examples.en: I pay the rent to my landlord on the first of each month.
examples.zh: 我每個月一號把房租付給房東。

examples.en: The farmer pays his landlord rent for the fields every year.
examples.zh: 這位農夫每年向地主支付田地租金。

examples.en: The doctor used a laser to fix his eyesight.
examples.zh: 醫生用雷射來矯正他的視力。

examples.en: The teacher pointed a laser at the screen.
examples.zh: 老師用雷射筆指向螢幕。

examples.en: This printer uses a laser to produce sharp text and images.
examples.zh: 這台印表機利用雷射，印出清晰的文字和影像。

examples.en: Put a layer of cheese on top of the pizza.
examples.zh: 在披薩上面鋪一層起司。

examples.en: It is cold today, so wear an extra layer of clothing.
examples.zh: 今天很冷，所以多穿一層衣服。

examples.en: A thick layer of dust covered the old books.
examples.zh: 一層厚厚的灰塵覆蓋著舊書。

examples.en: Layer the sliced fruit on the bottom of the cup.
examples.zh: 把水果片疊放在杯底。

examples.en: It is smart to layer your clothes in cold weather.
examples.zh: 天冷時一層層地穿衣服是聰明的做法。

examples.en: The artist layered colors to make the painting look deep.
examples.zh: 畫家一層層疊上顏色，讓畫看起來有深度。

examples.en: Our school team won first place in the baseball league.
examples.zh: 我們學校的隊伍拿下棒球聯賽第一名。

examples.en: He dreams of playing in the major leagues one day.
examples.zh: 他夢想有一天能在大聯盟打球。

examples.en: Several countries formed a league to protect trade.
examples.zh: 幾個國家組成聯盟來保護貿易。

examples.en: The legendary singer gave her last concert last night.
examples.zh: 那位傳奇歌手昨晚舉行了她最後一場演唱會。

examples.en: People still tell stories about the legendary king.
examples.zh: 人們仍在講述那位傳說中國王的故事。

examples.en: He is legendary for his kindness to students.
examples.zh: 他以對學生的和善而聞名。

examples.en: She tied the rope into a big loop.
examples.zh: 她把繩子綁成一個大圈。

examples.en: The train line makes a loop around the city.
examples.zh: 這條鐵路在市區繞成一個環狀。

examples.en: A loop in the program kept running forever.
examples.zh: 程式裡的一個迴圈一直無限地跑。

examples.en: He looped the string around the stick.
examples.zh: 他把繩子繞在棍子上成一圈。

examples.en: The path loops around the lake and returns to the start.
examples.zh: 這條小徑繞湖一圈後回到起點。

examples.en: She looped her scarf twice around her neck.
examples.zh: 她把圍巾在脖子上繞了兩圈。

examples.en: The rich family lives in a huge mansion on the hill.
examples.zh: 那個富有的家庭住在山丘上的一棟大豪宅。

examples.en: We visited an old mansion during our trip to the countryside.
examples.zh: 我們到鄉下旅遊時參觀了一棟老宅。

examples.en: The mansion has twenty rooms and a large garden.
examples.zh: 這棟豪宅有二十個房間和一座大花園。

examples.en: The Mona Lisa is a famous masterpiece.
examples.zh: 〈蒙娜麗莎〉是一幅著名的傑作。

examples.en: He spent ten years writing his masterpiece.
examples.zh: 他花了十年寫成他的傑作。

examples.en: The museum displays masterpieces from many countries.
examples.zh: 博物館展出許多國家的名作。

senses.zh: 其間的一段時間（常用於固定片語）

examples.en: The bus comes at noon; in the meantime, let's have a snack.
examples.zh: 公車中午才來，這段時間我們先吃點心吧。

examples.en: Dinner will be ready soon, but in the meantime you can wash your hands.
examples.zh: 晚餐很快就好，這段時間你可以先洗手。

examples.en: I will call him back; in the meantime, please wait here.
examples.zh: 我會回電給他，在這之前請在這裡等一下。
